Теперь вставь в этот терминал блок. Он создаст job dir, скачает GitHub repo и запустит depth `12` через `sbatch -p kaf12 start.sh`:

```bash
JOB=/mnt/pool/6/vokirova/beam8a100
mkdir -p "$JOB"
cd "$JOB"

cat > start.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=beam8a100
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks-per-node=8
#SBATCH --gres=gpu:a100:8
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=8
#SBATCH --time=04:00:00

set -euo pipefail

JOB_DIR="${SLURM_SUBMIT_DIR:-/mnt/pool/6/vokirova/beam8a100}"
REPO_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/repo"
BUILD_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/build-a100"
CUTLASS_DIR="${CUTLASS_DIR:-/mnt/pool/3/vokirova/cutlass}"
LOG_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/logs"
HISTORY_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/history"

mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR" "$HISTORY_DIR"

if [ ! -d "$REPO_DIR/.git" ]; then
  rm -rf "$REPO_DIR"
  git clone --branch main --depth 1 https://github.com/TryDotAtwo/MultiGPUBeamSearch.git "$REPO_DIR"
fi

cd "$REPO_DIR"
git fetch origin main --depth 1
git reset --hard origin/main

cmake -S "$REPO_DIR" -B "$BUILD_DIR" -G Ninja \
  -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
  -DCUTLASS_DIR="$CUTLASS_DIR" \
  -DBEAM_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=80 \
  -DBEAM_ENABLE_DEBUG=ON \
  -DBEAM_ENABLE_DEPTH_LOGS=ON

cmake --build "$BUILD_DIR" --target production_runner -j 8

export OMP_NUM_THREADS="${SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK:-8}"
export NCCL_DEBUG=WARN
export NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING=1
export CUDA_DEVICE_MAX_CONNECTIONS=32

export BEAM_WEIGHT_DIR="$REPO_DIR/stream1_weights"
export BEAM_DEPTH_LOG_EVERY=1
export BEAM_HISTORY_MODE=static_hybrid
export BEAM_HISTORY_SLOT_COUNT=2
export BEAM_HISTORY_WORKERS=4
export BEAM_HISTORY_RAM_BYTES=$((160 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024))
export BEAM_HISTORY_DISK_BYTES=$((384 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024))
export BEAM_HISTORY_DISK_PATH="$HISTORY_DIR"
export BEAM_SOLVED_NEIGHBORHOOD_RADIUS=5
export BEAM_PREDICT_STATS_VERBOSE=1
export BEAM_PREDICT_STATS_PATH="$JOB_DIR/predict_stats_p992_b260m_d12.jsonl"

export BEAM_RUNTIME_CONFIG_MODE=manual
export BEAM_B_MICRO=4096
export BEAM_STREAM1_CONCURRENCY=2
export BEAM_STREAM3_RING_SLOTS=4
export BEAM_SHARD_BUFFER_COUNT=2
export BEAM_SHARD_COUNT=64
export BEAM_STREAM4_BATCH_CANDIDATES=524288
export BEAM_STREAM4_TRIGGER_CANDIDATES=1048576
export BEAM_SHARD_CAPACITY_CANDIDATES=1052672
export BEAM_STREAM4_ACTIVE_SORT_SLOTS=4
export BEAM_GLOBAL_SPILL_CAPACITY=0
export BEAM_STREAM5_RECV_CAPACITY_SCALE_PPM=1200000
export BEAM_GPU_HEADROOM_BYTES=$((3 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024))

python3 -m torch.distributed.run \
  --nnodes=1 \
  --nproc-per-node=8 \
  --rdzv-backend=c10d \
  --rdzv-endpoint=127.0.0.1:29500 \
  --rdzv-id="beam8a100_${SLURM_JOB_ID:-manual}" \
  --no-python \
  "$BUILD_DIR/production_runner" 992 12 260000000 2>&1 | tee "$LOG_DIR/production_runner_p992_d12_b260m_${SLURM_JOB_ID:-manual}.log"
EOF

chmod +x start.sh
sbatch -p kaf12 start.sh
```

safe_remove_job_child_dir() {
  local target="$1"
  local label="$2"
  local resolved_job
  local resolved_target

  resolved_job="$(realpath -m "${JOB_DIR}")"
  resolved_target="$(realpath -m "${target}")"
  case "${resolved_target}" in
    "${resolved_job}/build-a100"|"${resolved_job}/history")

        echo "cleanup_remove_${label}=${resolved_target}"
        rm -rf --one-file-system "${resolved_target}"
      fi
      ;;
    *)

      ;;
  esac
}

cleanup() {
  local rc=$?
  echo "cleanup_start rc=${rc} at $(date -Is)"
  safe_remove_job_child_dir "${BUILD_DIR}" "build"
  if [ "${rc}" -eq 0 ]; then
    safe_remove_job_child_dir "${HISTORY_DIR}" "history"
  else
    echo "cleanup_keep_history=${HISTORY_DIR}"
  fi
  echo "cleanup_done rc=${rc} at $(date -Is)"
  exit "${rc}"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
```

Теперь вставь в этот терминал блок. Он создаст job dir, скачает GitHub repo и запустит depth `12` через `sbatch -p kaf12 start.sh`:

```bash
JOB=/mnt/pool/6/vokirova/beam8a100
mkdir -p "$JOB"
cd "$JOB"

cat > start.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=beam8a100
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks-per-node=8
#SBATCH --gres=gpu:a100:8
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=8
#SBATCH --time=04:00:00

set -euo pipefail

JOB_DIR="${SLURM_SUBMIT_DIR:-/mnt/pool/6/vokirova/beam8a100}"
REPO_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/repo"
BUILD_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/build-a100"
CUTLASS_DIR="${CUTLASS_DIR:-/mnt/pool/3/vokirova/cutlass}"
LOG_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/logs"
HISTORY_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/history"

mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR" "$HISTORY_DIR"

if [ ! -d "$REPO_DIR/.git" ]; then
  rm -rf "$REPO_DIR"
  git clone --branch main --depth 1 https://github.com/TryDotAtwo/MultiGPUBeamSearch.git "$REPO_DIR"
fi

cd "$REPO_DIR"
git fetch origin main --depth 1
git reset --hard origin/main

cmake -S "$REPO_DIR" -B "$BUILD_DIR" -G Ninja \
  -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
  -DCUTLASS_DIR="$CUTLASS_DIR" \
  -DBEAM_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=80 \
  -DBEAM_ENABLE_DEBUG=ON \
  -DBEAM_ENABLE_DEPTH_LOGS=ON

cmake --build "$BUILD_DIR" --target production_runner -j 8

export OMP_NUM_THREADS="${SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK:-8}"
export NCCL_DEBUG=WARN
export NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING=1
export CUDA_DEVICE_MAX_CONNECTIONS=32

export BEAM_WEIGHT_DIR="$REPO_DIR/stream1_weights"
export BEAM_DEPTH_LOG_EVERY=1
export BEAM_HISTORY_MODE=static_hybrid
export BEAM_HISTORY_SLOT_COUNT=2
export BEAM_HISTORY_WORKERS=4
export BEAM_HISTORY_RAM_BYTES=$((160 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024))
export BEAM_HISTORY_DISK_BYTES=$((384 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024))
export BEAM_HISTORY_DISK_PATH="$HISTORY_DIR"
export BEAM_SOLVED_NEIGHBORHOOD_RADIUS=5
export BEAM_PREDICT_STATS_VERBOSE=1
export BEAM_PREDICT_STATS_PATH="$JOB_DIR/predict_stats_p992_b260m_d12.jsonl"

export BEAM_RUNTIME_CONFIG_MODE=manual
export BEAM_B_MICRO=4096
export BEAM_STREAM1_CONCURRENCY=2
export BEAM_STREAM3_RING_SLOTS=4
export BEAM_SHARD_BUFFER_COUNT=2
export BEAM_SHARD_COUNT=64
export BEAM_STREAM4_BATCH_CANDIDATES=524288
export BEAM_STREAM4_TRIGGER_CANDIDATES=1048576
export BEAM_SHARD_CAPACITY_CANDIDATES=1052672
export BEAM_STREAM4_ACTIVE_SORT_SLOTS=4
export BEAM_GLOBAL_SPILL_CAPACITY=0
export BEAM_STREAM5_RECV_CAPACITY_SCALE_PPM=1200000
export BEAM_GPU_HEADROOM_BYTES=$((3 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024))

python3 -m torch.distributed.run \
  --nnodes=1 \
  --nproc-per-node=8 \
  --rdzv-backend=c10d \
  --rdzv-endpoint=127.0.0.1:29500 \
  --rdzv-id="beam8a100_${SLURM_JOB_ID:-manual}" \
  --no-python \
  "$BUILD_DIR/production_runner" 992 12 260000000 2>&1 | tee "$LOG_DIR/production_runner_p992_d12_b260m_${SLURM_JOB_ID:-manual}.log"
EOF

chmod +x start.sh
sbatch -p kaf12 start.sh
```

[106] assistant: Да, для короткого `depth=12` это завышено. В `production_runner` `BEAM_HISTORY_RAM_BYTES` трактуется как общий бюджет и делится на `WORLD_SIZE`, то есть `160 GiB / 8 = 20 GiB` на rank. На узле с `512 GiB RAM` это не абсурдно, но для пробного запуска глубины 12 лучше не резервировать так агрессивно.

Поставь консервативно:

```bash
export BEAM_HISTORY_RAM_BYTES=$((64 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024))
export BEAM_HISTORY_DISK_BYTES=$((192 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024))
```

Это даст примерно `8 GiB RAM/rank` и `24 GiB disk/rank`, для проверки сборки, torchrun/NCCL и первых depth должно хватить. Для полного `depth=80` потом вернем больше, исходя из фактических логов `history_bytes_*`.

```bash
cleanup() {
  rc=$?
  echo "cleanup_start rc=${rc} at $(date -Is)"
  rm -rf "${BUILD_DIR}"
  if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then
    rm -rf "${HISTORY_DIR}"
  else
    echo "keeping history for failed run: ${HISTORY_DIR}"
  fi
  echo "cleanup_done at $(date -Is)"
  exit "$rc"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
```

Для текущего depth 12 ставь второй вариант: build удалится всегда, history удалится только если run завершился успешно.

safe_remove_job_child_dir() {
  local target="$1"
  local label="$2"
  local resolved_job
  local resolved_target

  resolved_job="$(realpath -m "${JOB_DIR}")"
  resolved_target="$(realpath -m "${target}")"
  case "${resolved_target}" in
    "${resolved_job}/build-a100"|"${resolved_job}/history")

        echo "cleanup_remove_${label}=${resolved_target}"
        rm -rf --one-file-system "${resolved_target}"
      fi
      ;;
    *)
      echo "cleanup_skip_${label}=unsafe_path:${resolved_target}"
      ;;
  esac
}

cleanup() {
  local rc=$?
  echo "cleanup_start rc=${rc} at $(date -Is)"
  safe_remove_job_child_dir "${BUILD_DIR}" "build"
  if [ "${rc}" -eq 0 ]; then
    safe_remove_job_child_dir "${HISTORY_DIR}" "history"
  else
    echo "cleanup_keep_history=${HISTORY_DIR}"
  fi
  echo "cleanup_done rc=${rc} at $(date -Is)"
  exit "${rc}"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
```

#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=8

LOG_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/logs"
PREDICT_STATS_PATH="${JOB_DIR}/predict_stats_p992_b260m_d12.jsonl"

safe_remove_job_child_dir() {
  local target="$1"
  local label="$2"
  local resolved_job
  local resolved_target

  resolved_job="$(realpath -m "${JOB_DIR}")"
  resolved_target="$(realpath -m "${target}")"
  case "${resolved_target}" in
    "${resolved_job}/build-a100"|"${resolved_job}/history"|"${resolved_job}/repo")
      if [ -d "${resolved_target}" ]; then
        echo "cleanup_remove_${label}=${resolved_target}"
        rm -rf --one-file-system "${resolved_target}"
      fi
      ;;
    *)
      echo "cleanup_skip_${label}=unsafe_path:${resolved_target}"
      ;;
  esac
}

cleanup() {
  local rc=$?
  echo "cleanup_start rc=${rc} at $(date -Is)"
  safe_remove_job_child_dir "${BUILD_DIR}" "build"

    safe_remove_job_child_dir "${HISTORY_DIR}" "history"
  else
    echo "cleanup_keep_history=${HISTORY_DIR}"
  fi
  echo "cleanup_done rc=${rc} at $(date -Is)"
  exit "${rc}"
}

fi

git reset --hard "origin/${GITHUB_BRANCH}"

export OMP_NUM_THREADS="${SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK:-8}"

export NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING=1
export CUDA_DEVICE_MAX_CONNECTIONS=32

export BEAM_WEIGHT_DIR="${REPO_DIR}/stream1_weights"
export BEAM_DEPTH_LOG_EVERY=1
export BEAM_HISTORY_MODE=static_hybrid
export BEAM_HISTORY_SLOT_COUNT=2

#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=beam8a100
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks-per-node=8
#SBATCH --gres=gpu:a100:8
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=8
#SBATCH --time=12:00:00

set -euo pipefail

JOB_DIR="${SLURM_SUBMIT_DIR:-/mnt/pool/6/vokirova/beam8a100}"
REPO_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/repo"
BUILD_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/build-a100"
CUTLASS_DIR="${CUTLASS_DIR:-/mnt/pool/3/vokirova/cutlass}"
GITHUB_REPO_URL="${GITHUB_REPO_URL:-https://github.com/TryDotAtwo/MultiGPUBeamSearch.git}"
GITHUB_BRANCH="${GITHUB_BRANCH:-main}"
HISTORY_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/history"
LOG_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/logs"
PREDICT_STATS_PATH="${JOB_DIR}/predict_stats_p992_b260m_d12.jsonl"

safe_remove_job_child_dir() {
  local target="$1"
  local label="$2"
  local resolved_job
  local resolved_target

  resolved_job="$(realpath -m "${JOB_DIR}")"
  resolved_target="$(realpath -m "${target}")"
  case "${resolved_target}" in
    "${resolved_job}/build-a100"|"${resolved_job}/history"|"${resolved_job}/repo")
      if [ -d "${resolved_target}" ]; then
        echo "cleanup_remove_${label}=${resolved_target}"
        rm -rf --one-file-system "${resolved_target}"
      fi
      ;;
    *)
      echo "cleanup_skip_${label}=unsafe_path:${resolved_target}"
      ;;
  esac
}

cleanup() {
  local rc=$?
  echo "cleanup_start rc=${rc} at $(date -Is)"
  safe_remove_job_child_dir "${BUILD_DIR}" "build"
  if [ "${rc}" -eq 0 ]; then
    safe_remove_job_child_dir "${HISTORY_DIR}" "history"
  else
    echo "cleanup_keep_history=${HISTORY_DIR}"
  fi
  echo "cleanup_done rc=${rc} at $(date -Is)"
  exit "${rc}"
}

  --nproc-per-node=8 \

  --rdzv-id="beam8a100_${SLURM_JOB_ID:-manual}" \
  --no-python \
  "${BUILD_DIR}/production_runner" 992 12 260000000 2>&1 | tee "${RUN_LOG}"

echo "finished_at=$(date -Is)"

#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=beam8a100
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks=1
#SBATCH --gres=gpu:8
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=8
#SBATCH --time=12:00:00

set -euo pipefail

JOB_DIR="${SLURM_SUBMIT_DIR:-/mnt/pool/6/vokirova/beam8a100}"
REPO_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/repo"
BUILD_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/build-a100"
CUTLASS_DIR="${CUTLASS_DIR:-/mnt/pool/3/vokirova/cutlass}"
HISTORY_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/history"
LOG_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/logs"
PREDICT_STATS_PATH="${JOB_DIR}/predict_stats_p992_b260m_d12.jsonl"

safe_remove_job_child_dir() {
  local target="$1"
  local label="$2"
  local resolved_job
  local resolved_target
  resolved_job="$(realpath -m "${JOB_DIR}")"
  resolved_target="$(realpath -m "${target}")"
  case "${resolved_target}" in
    "${resolved_job}/build-a100"|"${resolved_job}/history")
      if [ -d "${resolved_target}" ]; then
        echo "cleanup_remove_${label}=${resolved_target}"
        rm -rf --one-file-system "${resolved_target}"
      fi
      ;;
    *)
      echo "cleanup_skip_${label}=unsafe_path:${resolved_target}"
      ;;
  esac
}

cleanup() {
  local rc=$?
  echo "cleanup_start rc=${rc} at $(date -Is)"
  safe_remove_job_child_dir "${BUILD_DIR}" "build"
  if [ "${rc}" -eq 0 ]; then
    safe_remove_job_child_dir "${HISTORY_DIR}" "history"
  else
    echo "cleanup_keep_history=${HISTORY_DIR}"
  fi
  echo "cleanup_done rc=${rc} at $(date -Is)"
  exit "${rc}"
}
trap cleanup EXIT

if [ ! -d "${REPO_DIR}/.git" ]; then
  echo "missing_repo=${REPO_DIR}"
  exit 2
fi
if [ ! -d "${CUTLASS_DIR}/include" ]; then
  echo "missing_cutlass=${CUTLASS_DIR}"
  exit 2
fi

mkdir -p "${BUILD_DIR}" "${HISTORY_DIR}" "${LOG_DIR}"
cd "${REPO_DIR}"

echo "job_dir=${JOB_DIR}"
echo "repo_dir=${REPO_DIR}"
git rev-parse HEAD
echo "started_at=$(date -Is)"
nvidia-smi

cmake -S "${REPO_DIR}" -B "${BUILD_DIR}" -G Ninja \
  -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
  -DCUTLASS_DIR="${CUTLASS_DIR}" \
  -DBEAM_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=80 \
  -DBEAM_ENABLE_DEBUG=ON \
  -DBEAM_ENABLE_DEPTH_LOGS=ON \
  -DBEAM_ENABLE_DEBUG_LOGS=OFF \
  -DBEAM_DEBUG_STREAM_TIMING=OFF \
  -DBEAM_DEBUG_INFERENCE_TRACE=OFF \
  -DBEAM_DEBUG_PATH_TRACE=OFF \
  -DBEAM_DEBUG_FINAL_VALIDATE=OFF \
  -DBEAM_DEBUG_FINAL_EXCHANGE_TRACE=OFF \
  -DBEAM_DEBUG_FINAL_HISTOGRAM_TRACE=OFF \
  -DBEAM_DEBUG_STREAM4_HISTOGRAM_TRACE=OFF \
  -DBEAM_DEBUG_DEPTH_FLOW_TRACE=OFF

cmake --build "${BUILD_DIR}" --target production_runner -j 8

export OMP_NUM_THREADS="${SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK:-8}"
export NCCL_DEBUG=WARN
export NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING=1
export CUDA_DEVICE_MAX_CONNECTIONS=32

export BEAM_WEIGHT_DIR="${REPO_DIR}/stream1_weights"
export BEAM_DEPTH_LOG_EVERY=1
export BEAM_HISTORY_MODE=static_hybrid
export BEAM_HISTORY_SLOT_COUNT=2
export BEAM_HISTORY_WORKERS=4
export BEAM_HISTORY_RAM_BYTES=$((160 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024))
export BEAM_HISTORY_DISK_BYTES=$((384 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024))
export BEAM_HISTORY_DISK_PATH="${HISTORY_DIR}"
export BEAM_SOLVED_NEIGHBORHOOD_RADIUS=5
export BEAM_SOLVED_NEIGHBORHOOD_MAX_ENTRIES=3000000
export BEAM_STREAM2_SUFFIX_RADIUS=0
export BEAM_STREAM2_SUFFIX_BACKEND=composed_permutations
export BEAM_STREAM2_SUFFIX_MAX_COUNT=1
export BEAM_PREDICT_STATS_VERBOSE=1
export BEAM_PREDICT_STATS_PATH="${PREDICT_STATS_PATH}"

export BEAM_RUNTIME_CONFIG_MODE=manual
export BEAM_B_MICRO=4096
export BEAM_STREAM1_CONCURRENCY=2
export BEAM_STREAM3_RING_SLOTS=4
export BEAM_SHARD_BUFFER_COUNT=2
export BEAM_SHARD_COUNT=64
export BEAM_STREAM4_BATCH_CANDIDATES=524288
export BEAM_STREAM4_TRIGGER_CANDIDATES=1048576
export BEAM_SHARD_CAPACITY_CANDIDATES=1052672
export BEAM_STREAM4_ACTIVE_SORT_SLOTS=4
export BEAM_GLOBAL_SPILL_CAPACITY=0
export BEAM_STREAM5_RECV_CAPACITY_SCALE_PPM=1200000
export BEAM_GPU_HEADROOM_BYTES=$((3 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024))

RUN_LOG="${LOG_DIR}/production_runner_p992_d12_b260m_${SLURM_JOB_ID:-manual}.log"
echo "run_log=${RUN_LOG}"

python3 -m torch.distributed.run \
  --nnodes=1 \
  --nproc-per-node=8 \
  --rdzv-backend=c10d \
  --rdzv-endpoint=127.0.0.1:29500 \
  --rdzv-id="beam8a100_${SLURM_JOB_ID:-manual}" \
  --no-python \
  "${BUILD_DIR}/production_runner" 992 12 260000000 2>&1 | tee "${RUN_LOG}"

echo "finished_at=$(date -Is)"
EOF

bash -n start_nonet.sh
chmod +x start_nonet.sh
sbatch -p kaf12 start_nonet.sh
```

#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=beam8a100
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks=1
#SBATCH --gres=gpu:8
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=8
#SBATCH --time=12:00:00

set -euo pipefail

JOB_DIR="${SLURM_SUBMIT_DIR:-/mnt/pool/6/vokirova/beam8a100}"
REPO_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/repo"
BUILD_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/build-a100"
CUTLASS_DIR="${CUTLASS_DIR:-/mnt/pool/3/vokirova/cutlass}"
HISTORY_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/history"
LOG_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/logs"
PREDICT_STATS_PATH="${JOB_DIR}/predict_stats_p992_b260m_d12.jsonl"

safe_remove_job_child_dir() {
  local target="$1"
  local label="$2"
  local resolved_job
  local resolved_target

  resolved_job="$(realpath -m "${JOB_DIR}")"
  resolved_target="$(realpath -m "${target}")"
  case "${resolved_target}" in
    "${resolved_job}/build-a100"|"${resolved_job}/history")
      if [ -d "${resolved_target}" ]; then
        echo "cleanup_remove_${label}=${resolved_target}"
        rm -rf --one-file-system "${resolved_target}"
      fi
      ;;
    *)
      echo "cleanup_skip_${label}=unsafe_path:${resolved_target}"
      ;;
  esac
}

cleanup() {
  local rc=$?
  echo "cleanup_start rc=${rc} at $(date -Is)"
  safe_remove_job_child_dir "${BUILD_DIR}" "build"
  if [ "${rc}" -eq 0 ]; then
    safe_remove_job_child_dir "${HISTORY_DIR}" "history"
  else
    echo "cleanup_keep_history=${HISTORY_DIR}"
  fi
  echo "cleanup_done rc=${rc} at $(date -Is)"
  exit "${rc}"
}
trap cleanup EXIT

mkdir -p "${JOB_DIR}" "${BUILD_DIR}" "${HISTORY_DIR}" "${LOG_DIR}"
if [ ! -d "${REPO_DIR}/.git" ]; then
  echo "missing_repo=${REPO_DIR}"
  exit 2
fi
if [ ! -d "${CUTLASS_DIR}/include" ]; then
  echo "missing_cutlass=${CUTLASS_DIR}"
  exit 2
fi
cd "${REPO_DIR}"

echo "job_dir=${JOB_DIR}"
echo "repo_dir=${REPO_DIR}"
git rev-parse HEAD
echo "started_at=$(date -Is)"
nvidia-smi

cmake -S "${REPO_DIR}" -B "${BUILD_DIR}" -G Ninja \
  -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
  -DCUTLASS_DIR="${CUTLASS_DIR}" \
  -DBEAM_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=80 \
  -DBEAM_ENABLE<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="45" /> -DBEAM_DEBUG_FINAL_EXCHANGE_TRACE=OFF \
  -DBEAM_DEBUG_FINAL_HISTOGRAM_TRACE=OFF \
  -DBEAM_DEBUG_STREAM4_HISTOGRAM_TRACE=OFF \
  -DBEAM_DEBUG_DEPTH_FLOW_TRACE=OFF

cmake --build "${BUILD_DIR}" --target production_runner -j 8

export OMP_NUM_THREADS="${SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK:-8}"
export NCCL_DEBUG=WARN
export NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING=1
export CUDA_DEVICE_MAX_CONNECTIONS=32

export BEAM_WEIGHT_DIR="${REPO_DIR}/stream1_weights"
export BEAM_DEPTH_LOG_EVERY=1
export BEAM_HISTORY_MODE=static_hybrid
export BEAM_HISTORY_SLOT_COUNT=2
export BEAM_HISTORY_WORKERS=4
export BEAM_HISTORY_RAM_BYTES=$((160 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024))
export BEAM_HISTORY_DISK_BYTES=$((384 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024))
export BEAM_HISTORY_DISK_PATH="${HISTORY_DIR}"
export BEAM_SOLVED_NEIGHBORHOOD_RADIUS=5
export BEAM_SOLVED_NEIGHBORHOOD_MAX_ENTRIES=3000000
export BEAM_STREAM2_SUFFIX_RADIUS=0
export BEAM_STREAM2_SUFFIX_BACKEND=composed_permutations
export BEAM_STREAM2_SUFFIX_MAX_COUNT=1
export BEAM_PREDICT_STATS_VERBOSE=1
export BEAM_PREDICT_STATS_PATH="${PREDICT_STATS_PATH}"

export BEAM_RUNTIME_CONFIG_MODE=manual
export BEAM_B_MICRO=4096
export BEAM_STREAM1_CONCURRENCY=2
export BEAM_STREAM3_RING_SLOTS=4
export BEAM_SHARD_BUFFER_COUNT=2
export BEAM_SHARD_COUNT=64
export BEAM_STREAM4_BATCH_CANDIDATES=524288
export BEAM_STREAM4_TRIGGER_CANDIDATES=1048576
export BEAM_SHARD_CAPACITY_CANDIDATES=1052672
export BEAM_STREAM4_ACTIVE_SORT_SLOTS=4
export BEAM_GLOBAL_SPILL_CAPACITY=0
export BEAM_STREAM5_RECV_CAPACITY_SCALE_PPM=1200000
export BEAM_GPU_HEADROOM_BYTES=$((3 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024))

RUN_LOG="${LOG_DIR}/production_runner_p992_d12_b260m_${SLURM_JOB_ID:-manual}.log"
echo "run_log=${RUN_LOG}"

python3 -m torch.distributed.run \
  --nnodes=1 \
  --nproc-per-node=8 \
  --rdzv-backend=c10d \
  --rdzv-endpoint=127.0.0.1:29500 \
  --rdzv-id="beam8a100_${SLURM_JOB_ID:-manual}" \
  --no-python \
  "${BUILD_DIR}/production_runner" 992 12 260000000 2>&1 | tee "${RUN_LOG}"

echo "finished_at=$(date -Is)"

Use this only from the visible MEPhI terminal gateway:

```

Then prepare and submit:

```bash
JOB=/mnt/pool/6/vokirova/beam8a100

cd "$JOB"

git clone --branch main --depth 1 https://github.com/TryDotAtwo/MultiGPUBeamSearch.git repo

  git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/NVIDIA/cutlass.git /mnt/pool/3/vokirova/cutlass
fi

cp repo/hpc/start_8xa100_beamsearch.sh start.sh
sed -i 's/\r$//' start.sh
bash -n start.sh
chmod +x start.sh
sbatch -p kaf12 start.sh
```

To update an existing checkout before resubmitting:

```bash
cd /mnt/pool/6/vokirova/beam8a100/repo
git fetch origin main --depth 1
git reset --hard origin/main

cd /mnt/pool/6/vokirova/beam8a100
cp repo/hpc/start_8xa100_beamsearch.sh start.sh
sed -i 's/\r$//' start.sh
bash -n start.sh
chmod +x start.sh
sbatch -p kaf12 start.sh
```

Check the job:

scontrol show job <job_id>
cat /mnt/pool/6/vokirova/beam8a100/slurm-<job_id>.out
tail -n 200 /mnt/pool/6/vokirova/beam8a100/logs/production_runner_p992_d12_b260m_<job_id>.log
```

Run parameters:

- puzzle: `992`
- depth: `12`
- global beam: `260000000`
- GPUs/ranks: `8`
- CUDA architecture: `sm_80`
- solved-neighborhood radius: `5`

- Removes only `/mnt/pool/6/vokirova/beam8a100/history` after a successful
  run.
- Keeps `history` after a failed run for diagnostics.
- Never removes `repo`, `logs`, `slurm-*.out`, `predict_stats`, or
  `/mnt/pool/3/vokirova/cutlass` during normal job cleanup.

Network rule:

- `start.sh` does not run `git clone`, `git fetch`, or `git reset` inside the
  compute job. Prepare `repo/` and `/mnt/pool/3/vokirova/cutlass` from the
  visible `basis` shell before `sbatch`.

HISTORY_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/history"
LOG_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/logs"
PREDICT_STATS_PATH="${JOB_DIR}/predict_stats_p992_b260m_d12.jsonl"

safe_remove_job_child_dir() {
  local target="$1"
  local label="$2"
  local resolved_job
  local resolved_target

  resolved_job="$(realpath -m "${JOB_DIR}")"
  resolved_target="$(realpath -m "${target}")"
  case "${resolved_target}" in
    "${resolved_job}/build-a100"|"${resolved_job}/history")
      if [ -d "${resolved_target}" ]; then
        echo "cleanup_remove_${label}=${resolved_target}"
        rm -rf --one-file-system "${resolved_target}"
      fi
      ;;
    *)
      echo "cleanup_skip_${label}=unsafe_path:${resolved_target}"
      ;;
  esac
}

cleanup() {
  local rc=$?
  echo "cleanup_start rc=${rc} at $(date -Is)"
  safe_remove_job_child_dir "${BUILD_DIR}" "build"
  if [ "${rc}" -eq 0 ]; then
    safe_remove_job_child_dir "${HISTORY_DIR}" "history"
  else
    echo "cleanup_keep_history=${HISTORY_DIR}"
  fi
  echo "cleanup_done rc=${rc} at $(date -Is)"
  exit "${rc}"
}

```bash

cat > start_nonet.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=beam8a100
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks=1
#SBATCH --gres=gpu:8
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=8
#SBATCH --time=12:00:00

set -euo pipefail

JOB_DIR="${SLURM_SUBMIT_DIR:-/mnt/pool/6/vokirova/beam8a100}"
REPO_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/repo"
BUILD_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/build-a100"
CUTLASS_DIR="${CUTLASS_DIR:-/mnt/pool/3/vokirova/cutlass}"
HISTORY_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/history"
LOG_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/logs"
PREDICT_STATS_PATH="${JOB_DIR}/predict_stats_p992_b260m_d12.jsonl"

safe_remove_job_child_dir() {
  local target="$1"
  local label="$2"
  local resolved_job
  local resolved_target
  resolved_job="$(realpath -m "${JOB_DIR}")"
  resolved_target="$(realpath -m "${target}")"
  case "${resolved_target}" in
    "${resolved_job}/build-a100"|"${resolved_job}/history")
      if [ -d "${resolved_target}" ]; then
        echo "cleanup_remove_${label}=${resolved_target}"
        rm -rf --one-file-system "${resolved_target}"
      fi
      ;;
    *)
      echo "cleanup_skip_${label}=unsafe_path:${resolved_target}"
      ;;
  esac
}

cleanup() {
  local rc=$?
  echo "cleanup_start rc=${rc} at $(date -Is)"
  safe_remove_job_child_dir "${BUILD_DIR}" "build"
  if [ "${rc}" -eq 0 ]; then
    safe_remove_job_child_dir "${HISTORY_DIR}" "history"
  else
    echo "cleanup_keep_history=${HISTORY_DIR}"
  fi
  echo "cleanup_done rc=${rc} at $(date -Is)"
  exit "${rc}"
}
trap cleanup EXIT

if [ ! -d "${REPO_DIR}/.git" ]; then
  echo "missing_repo=${REPO_DIR}"
  exit 2
fi
if [ ! -d "${CUTLASS_DIR}/include" ]; then
  echo "missing_cutlass=${CUTLASS_DIR}"
  exit 2
fi

mkdir -p "${BUILD_DIR}" "${HISTORY_DIR}" "${LOG_DIR}"
cd "${REPO_DIR}"

echo "job_dir=${JOB_DIR}"
echo "repo_dir=${REPO_DIR}"
git rev-parse HEAD

nvidia-smi

cmake --build "${BUILD_DIR}" --target production_runner -j 8

export OMP_NUM_THREADS="${SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK:-8}"
export NCCL_DEBUG=WARN
export NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING=1

export BEAM_WEIGHT_DIR="${REPO_DIR}/stream1_weights"

export BEAM_RUNTIME_CONFIG_MODE=manual
export BEAM_B_MICRO=4096
export BEAM_STREAM1_CONCURRENCY=2

echo "run_log=${RUN_LOG}"

python3 -m torch.distributed.run \

  --nproc-per-node=8 \
  --rdzv-backend=c10d \
  --rdzv-endpoint=127.0.0.1:29500 \
  --rdzv-id="beam8a100_${SLURM_JOB_ID:-manual}" \

  "${BUILD_DIR}/production_runner" 992 12 260000000 2>&1 | tee "${RUN_LOG}"

echo "finished_at=$(date -Is)"
EOF

bash -n start_nonet.sh
chmod +x start_nonet.sh
sbatch -p kaf12 start_nonet.sh

#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=beam8a100
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks=1
#SBATCH --gres=gpu:8
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=8
#SBATCH --time=12:00:00

set -euo pipefail

JOB_DIR="${SLURM_SUBMIT_DIR:-/mnt/pool/6/vokirova/beam8a100}"
REPO_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/repo"
BUILD_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/build-a100"
CUTLASS_DIR="${CUTLASS_DIR:-/mnt/pool/3/vokirova/cutlass}"
HISTORY_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/history"
LOG_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/logs"
PREDICT_STATS_PATH="${JOB_DIR}/predict_stats_p992_b260m_d12.jsonl"

safe_remove_job_child_dir() {
  local target="$1"
  local label="$2"
  local resolved_job
  local resolved_target

  resolved_job="$(realpath -m "${JOB_DIR}")"
  resolved_target="$(realpath -m "${target}")"
  case "${resolved_target}" in
    "${resolved_job}/build-a100"|"${resolved_job}/history")
      if [ -d "${resolved_target}" ]; then
        echo "cleanup_remove_${label}=${resolved_target}"
        rm -rf --one-file-system "${resolved_target}"
      fi
      ;;
    *)
      echo "cleanup_skip_${label}=unsafe_path:${resolved_target}"
      ;;
  esac
}

cleanup() {
  local rc=$?
  echo "cleanup_start rc=${rc} at $(date -Is)"
  safe_remove_job_child_dir "${BUILD_DIR}" "build"
  if [ "${rc}" -eq 0 ]; then
    safe_remove_job_child_dir "${HISTORY_DIR}" "history"
  else
    echo "cleanup_keep_history=${HISTORY_DIR}"
  fi
  echo "cleanup_done rc=${rc} at $(date -Is)"
  exit "${rc}"
}
trap cleanup EXIT

mkdir -p "${JOB_DIR}" "${BUILD_DIR}" "${HISTORY_DIR}" "${LOG_DIR}"
if [ ! -d "${REPO_DIR}/.git" ]; then
  echo "missing_repo=${REPO_DIR}"
  exit 2
fi
if [ ! -d "${CUTLASS_DIR}/include" ]; then
  echo "missing_cutlass=${CUTLASS_DIR}"
  exit 2
fi
cd "${REPO_DIR}"

echo "job_dir=${JOB_DIR}"
echo "repo_dir=${REPO_DIR}"
git rev-parse HEAD
echo "started_at=$(date -Is)"
nvidia-smi

cmake -S "${REPO_DIR}" -B "${BUILD_DIR}" -G Ninja \
  -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
  -DCUTLASS_DIR="${CUTLASS_DIR}" \
  -DBEAM_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=80 \
  -DBEAM_ENABLE<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="45" /> -DBEAM_DEBUG_FINAL_EXCHANGE_TRACE=OFF \
  -DBEAM_DEBUG_FINAL_HISTOGRAM_TRACE=OFF \
  -DBEAM_DEBUG_STREAM4_HISTOGRAM_TRACE=OFF \
  -DBEAM_DEBUG_DEPTH_FLOW_TRACE=OFF

cmake --build "${BUILD_DIR}" --target production_runner -j 8

export OMP_NUM_THREADS="${SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK:-8}"
export NCCL_DEBUG=WARN
export NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING=1
export CUDA_DEVICE_MAX_CONNECTIONS=32

export BEAM_WEIGHT_DIR="${REPO_DIR}/stream1_weights"
export BEAM_DEPTH_LOG_EVERY=1
export BEAM_HISTORY_MODE=static_hybrid
export BEAM_HISTORY_SLOT_COUNT=2
export BEAM_HISTORY_WORKERS=4
export BEAM_HISTORY_RAM_BYTES=$((160 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024))
export BEAM_HISTORY_DISK_BYTES=$((384 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024))
export BEAM_HISTORY_DISK_PATH="${HISTORY_DIR}"
export BEAM_SOLVED_NEIGHBORHOOD_RADIUS=5
export BEAM_SOLVED_NEIGHBORHOOD_MAX_ENTRIES=3000000
export BEAM_STREAM2_SUFFIX_RADIUS=0
export BEAM_STREAM2_SUFFIX_BACKEND=composed_permutations
export BEAM_STREAM2_SUFFIX_MAX_COUNT=1
export BEAM_PREDICT_STATS_VERBOSE=1
export BEAM_PREDICT_STATS_PATH="${PREDICT_STATS_PATH}"

export BEAM_RUNTIME_CONFIG_MODE=manual
export BEAM_B_MICRO=4096
export BEAM_STREAM1_CONCURRENCY=2
export BEAM_STREAM3_RING_SLOTS=4
export BEAM_SHARD_BUFFER_COUNT=2
export BEAM_SHARD_COUNT=64
export BEAM_STREAM4_BATCH_CANDIDATES=524288
export BEAM_STREAM4_TRIGGER_CANDIDATES=1048576
export BEAM_SHARD_CAPACITY_CANDIDATES=1052672
export BEAM_STREAM4_ACTIVE_SORT_SLOTS=4
export BEAM_GLOBAL_SPILL_CAPACITY=0
export BEAM_STREAM5_RECV_CAPACITY_SCALE_PPM=1200000
export BEAM_GPU_HEADROOM_BYTES=$((3 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024))

RUN_LOG="${LOG_DIR}/production_runner_p992_d12_b260m_${SLURM_JOB_ID:-manual}.log"
echo "run_log=${RUN_LOG}"

python3 -m torch.distributed.run \
  --nnodes=1 \
  --nproc-per-node=8 \
  --rdzv-backend=c10d \
  --rdzv-endpoint=127.0.0.1:29500 \
  --rdzv-id="beam8a100_${SLURM_JOB_ID:-manual}" \
  --no-python \
  "${BUILD_DIR}/production_runner" 992 12 260000000 2>&1 | tee "${RUN_LOG}"

echo "finished_at=$(date -Is)"

# MEPhI 8xA100 Beam Search Launch

Use this only from the visible MEPhI terminal gateway:

```bash
ssh mephi
ssh basis
```

Then prepare and submit:

```bash
JOB=/mnt/pool/6/vokirova/beam8a100

if [ ! -d /mnt/pool/3/vokirova/cutlass/include ]; then
  mkdir -p /mnt/pool/3/vokirova
  git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/NVIDIA/cutlass.git /mnt/pool/3/vokirova/cutlass
fi

cp repo/hpc/start_8xa100_beamsearch.sh start.sh
sed -i 's/\r$//' start.sh
bash -n start.sh
chmod +x start.sh
sbatch -p kaf12 start.sh
```

To update an existing checkout before resubmitting:

```bash

git reset --hard origin/main

cd /mnt/pool/6/vokirova/beam8a100
cp repo/hpc/start_8xa100_beamsearch.sh start.sh
sed -i 's/\r$//' start.sh
bash -n start.sh
chmod +x start.sh
sbatch -p kaf12 start.sh
```

cat /mnt/pool/6/vokirova/beam8a100/slurm-<job_id>.out
tail -n 200 /mnt/pool/6/vokirova/beam8a100/logs/production_runner_p992_d12_b260m_<job_id>.log
```

Run parameters:

- puzzle: `992`
- depth: `12`
- global beam: `260000000`
- GPUs/ranks: `8`
- CUDA architecture: `sm_80`
- solved-neighborhood radius: `5`
- history mode: `static_hybrid`
- Stream3 prediction stats: enabled at `predict_stats_p992_b260m_d80.jsonl`

Cleanup behavior:

- Always removes only `/mnt/pool/6/vokirova/beam8a100/build-a100`.
- Removes only `/mnt/pool/6/vokirova/beam8a100/history` after a successful
  run.
- Keeps `history` after a failed run for diagnostics.
- Never removes `repo`, `logs`, `slurm-*.out`, `predict_stats`, or
  `/mnt/pool/3/vokirova/cutlass` during normal job cleanup.

Network rule:

- `start.sh` does not run `git clone`, `git fetch`, or `git reset` inside the
  compute job. Prepare `repo/` and `/mnt/pool/3/vokirova/cutlass` from the
  visible `basis` shell before `sbatch`.

Для Ninja безопасный вариант:

```bash
cd /mnt/pool/3/vokirova
python3 -m venv ninja-venv
source /mnt/pool/3/vokirova/ninja-venv/bin/activate

python -m pip install ninja
which ninja
ninja --version
```

Потом в `start.sh` перед `cmake` добавить:

```bash
export PATH="/mnt/pool/3/vokirova/ninja-venv/bin:$PATH"

И оставить CMake как сейчас с `-G Ninja`.

Это кластеру не вредит: установка идет в личный каталог `/mnt/pool/3/vokirova`, без `sudo`, без системных директорий, и job просто берет `ninja` из личного venv. Лучше ставить это на `basis` в видимом терминале, не внутри `sbatch`, чтобы compute-job не тратил время и не зависел от сети.

#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=beam8a100
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks=1
#SBATCH --gres=gpu:8
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=8
#SBATCH --time=12:00:00

set -euo pipefail

JOB_DIR="${SLURM_SUBMIT_DIR:-/mnt/pool/6/vokirova/beam8a100}"
REPO_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/repo"
BUILD_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/build-a100"
CUTLASS_DIR="${CUTLASS_DIR:-/mnt/pool/3/vokirova/cutlass}"
NINJA_VENV_DIR="${NINJA_VENV_DIR:-/mnt/pool/3/vokirova/ninja-venv}"
HISTORY_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/history"
LOG_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/logs"
PREDICT_STATS_PATH="${JOB_DIR}/predict_stats_p992_b260m_d12.jsonl"

safe_remove_job_child_dir() {
  local target="$1"
  local label="$2"
  local resolved_job
  local resolved_target

  resolved_job="$(realpath -m "${JOB_DIR}")"
  resolved_target="$(realpath -m "${target}")"
  case "${resolved_target}" in
    "${resolved_job}/build-a100"|"${resolved_job}/history")

#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=beam8a100
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks=1
#SBATCH --gres=gpu:8
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=8
#SBATCH --time=12:00:00

set -euo pipefail

JOB_DIR="${SLURM_SUBMIT_DIR:-/mnt/pool/6/vokirova/beam8a100}"
REPO_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/repo"
BUILD_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/build-a100"
CUTLASS_DIR="${CUTLASS_DIR:-/mnt/pool/3/vokirova/cutlass}"
NINJA_VENV_DIR="${NINJA_VENV_DIR:-/mnt/pool/3/vokirova/ninja-venv}"
HISTORY_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/history"
LOG_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/logs"
PREDICT_STATS_PATH="${JOB_DIR}/predict_stats_p992_b260m_d12.jsonl"

safe_remove_job_child_dir() {
  local target="$1"
  local label="$2"
  local resolved_job
  local resolved_target

  resolved_job="$(realpath -m "${JOB_DIR}")"
  resolved_target="$(realpath -m "${target}")"
  case "${resolved_target}" in
    "${resolved_job}/build-a100"|"${resolved_job}/history")
      if [ -d "${resolved_target}" ]; then
        echo "cleanup_remove_${label}=${resolved_target}"
        rm -rf --one-file-system "${resolved_target}"
      fi
      ;;
    *)
      echo "cleanup_skip_${label}=unsafe_path:${resolved_target}"
      ;;
  esac
}

cleanup() {
  local rc=$?
  echo "cleanup_start rc=${rc} at $(date -Is)"
  safe_remove_job_child_dir "${BUILD_DIR}" "build"
  if [ "${rc}" -eq 0 ]; then
    safe_remove_job_child_dir "${HISTORY_DIR}" "history"
  else
    echo "cleanup_keep_history=${HISTORY_DIR}"
  fi
  echo "cleanup_done rc=${rc} at $(date -Is)"
  exit "${rc}"
}
trap cleanup EXIT

mkdir -p "${JOB_DIR}" "${BUILD_DIR}" "${HISTORY_DIR}" "${LOG_DIR}"
if [ -x "${NINJA_VENV_DIR}/bin/ninja" ]; then
  export PATH="${NINJA_VENV_DIR}/bin:${PATH}"
else
  echo "missing_ninja=${NINJA_VENV_DIR}/bin/ninja"
  exit 2
fi
if [ ! -d "${REPO_DIR}/.git" ]; then
  echo "missing_repo=${REPO_DIR}"
  exit 2
fi
if [ ! -d "${CUTLASS_DIR}/include" ]; then
  echo "missing_cutlass=${CUTLASS_DIR}"
  exit 2
fi
cd "${REPO_DIR}"

echo "job_dir=${JOB_DIR}"
echo "repo_dir=${REPO_DIR}<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="106" /> -DBEAM_DEBUG_FINAL_EXCHANGE_TRACE=OFF \
  -DBEAM_DEBUG_FINAL_HISTOGRAM_TRACE=OFF \
  -DBEAM_DEBUG_STREAM4_HISTOGRAM_TRACE=OFF \
  -DBEAM_DEBUG_DEPTH_FLOW_TRACE=OFF

cmake --build "${BUILD_DIR}" --target production_runner -j 8

export OMP_NUM_THREADS="${SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK:-8}"
export NCCL_DEBUG=WARN
export NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING=1
export CUDA_DEVICE_MAX_CONNECTIONS=32

export BEAM_WEIGHT_DIR="${REPO_DIR}/stream1_weights"
export BEAM_DEPTH_LOG_EVERY=1
export BEAM_HISTORY_MODE=static_hybrid
export BEAM_HISTORY_SLOT_COUNT=2
export BEAM_HISTORY_WORKERS=4
export BEAM_HISTORY_RAM_BYTES=$((160 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024))
export BEAM_HISTORY_DISK_BYTES=$((384 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024))
export BEAM_HISTORY_DISK_PATH="${HISTORY_DIR}"
export BEAM_SOLVED_NEIGHBORHOOD_RADIUS=5
export BEAM_SOLVED_NEIGHBORHOOD_MAX_ENTRIES=3000000
export BEAM_STREAM2_SUFFIX_RADIUS=0
export BEAM_STREAM2_SUFFIX_BACKEND=composed_permutations
export BEAM_STREAM2_SUFFIX_MAX_COUNT=1
export BEAM_PREDICT_STATS_VERBOSE=1
export BEAM_PREDICT_STATS_PATH="${PREDICT_STATS_PATH}"

export BEAM_RUNTIME_CONFIG_MODE=manual
export BEAM_B_MICRO=4096
export BEAM_STREAM1_CONCURRENCY=2
export BEAM_STREAM3_RING_SLOTS=4
export BEAM_SHARD_BUFFER_COUNT=2
export BEAM_SHARD_COUNT=64
export BEAM_STREAM4_BATCH_CANDIDATES=524288
export BEAM_STREAM4_TRIGGER_CANDIDATES=1048576
export BEAM_SHARD_CAPACITY_CANDIDATES=1052672
export BEAM_STREAM4_ACTIVE_SORT_SLOTS=4
export BEAM_GLOBAL_SPILL_CAPACITY=0
export BEAM_STREAM5_RECV_CAPACITY_SCALE_PPM=1200000
export BEAM_GPU_HEADROOM_BYTES=$((3 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024))

RUN_LOG="${LOG_DIR}/production_runner_p992_d12_b260m_${SLURM_JOB_ID:-manual}.log"
echo "run_log=${RUN_LOG}"

python3 -m torch.distributed.run \
  --nnodes=1 \
  --nproc-per-node=8 \
  --rdzv-backend=c10d \
  --rdzv-endpoint=127.0.0.1:29500 \
  --rdzv-id="beam8a100_${SLURM_JOB_ID:-manual}" \
  --no-python \
  "${BUILD_DIR}/production_runner" 992 12 260000000 2>&1 | tee "${RUN_LOG}"

echo "finished_at=$(date -Is)"

```text
/usr/bin/python3
torch_import_error ModuleNotFoundError("No module named 'torch'")
```

И поиск NCCL опять не дал путей. Значит на `basis/t2n1` сейчас нет ни NCCL dev headers, ни torch/NCCL wheel.

Самый безопасный путь по FAQ: поставить **NCCL dev files и torch в личный venv/каталог `/mnt/pool/3/vokirova`**, без `sudo`. Так как `torch.distributed.run` все равно нужен для запуска, лучше сделать отдельный runtime venv, а не смешивать с `ninja-venv`.

Команды для видимого терминала:

```bash
cd /mnt/pool/3/vokirova
python3 -m venv beam-venv
source /mnt/pool/3/vokirova/beam-venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install --upgrade pip

python -m pip install torch --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu124
python -m pip install nvidia-nccl-cu12
```

Потом проверить:

```bash
python - <<'PY'
import sys, torch, pathlib
print(sys.executable)
print("torch", torch.__version__)
base = pathlib.Path(sys.prefix)
for p in base.rglob("libnccl.so*"):
    print("lib", p)
for p in base.rglob("nccl.h"):
    print("hdr", p)
PY
```

Если `nvidia-nccl-cu12` даст только `libnccl.so`, но не `nccl.h`, тогда поставим headers отдельно в `/mnt/pool/3/vokirova/nccl` и добавим в CMake `-DNCCL_INCLUDE_DIR=... -DNCCL_LIBRARY=...`.

# Work With Kaggle

Use this skill whenever the task involves Kaggle notebooks, kernels, datasets, or GPU validation runs.

## Project Memory First

For project repositories, read local project guidance before changing notebooks or source:

- `AGENTS.md`
- `memory/PROMPTS.md` and `memory/CHANGELOG.md`, especially recent Kaggle entries
- relevant `test_results/kaggle_*` reports for the same failure/config family

This project has many Kaggle-specific decisions preserved in memory. Do not assume a generic Kaggle workflow is correct when project memory says otherwise.

## Safety And Scope

- Do not upload or publish current uncommitted source to a Kaggle dataset unless the user explicitly approves external export.
- Prefer GitHub-backed Kaggle source when the user has selected GitHub as source of truth.
- Do not push a public Kaggle notebook/kernel unless the user explicitly approves publication or public push.
- Do not make C++/CUDA algorithmic changes while diagnosing Kaggle failures unless the user explicitly approves code changes. Config-only notebook changes are acceptable when useful and consistent with the request.
- Do not revert unrelated local changes. Kaggle notebook edits often coexist with dirty source changes.
- For multi-rank validation, do not fake `WORLD_SIZE=2` on one GPU with both ranks on `LOCAL_RANK=0` unless the user explici<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="692" />ed logs. This rule came from project memory and applies to diagnostic/watch tasks.
- Do not stop production/no-timeout runs unless the user explicitly asks or the notebook itself has a configured timeout.
- If a run appears hung because stdout is redirected, check rank log files and whether live-rank streaming is enabled before assuming a stall.
- Preserve logs even when stopping: terminate gracefully when possible, then download output files.

## Failure Diagnosis Checklist

After a Kaggle failure, collect and scan:

- Kaggle worker status and kernel version
- notebook stdout tail
- rank logs under the notebook output directory
- result JSONL/CSV summaries
- GPU budget/preflight output
- explicit Kaggle messages such as disk quota failures

Common patterns in this project:

- `KernelWorkerStatus.ERROR` plus "more disk space than is available" usually means disk quota/static history arena pressure.
- `return_code=-9` can indicate host RAM OOM.
- `code=3002` / `STREAM_FATAL_STREAM3_DOUBLE_BUFFER_OVERFLOW` points to Stream3/Stream4/threshold/capacity flow diagnostics.
- `final selected count does not match score phase counts` points to final selection/histogram/exact-count mismatch.
- `cudaGraphInstantiate: out of memory` may require config-only headroom/shard-capacity changes before deeper code work.
- Silent output after build may simply mean rank stdout is redirected and live rank logging is disabled.

Write a short report under `test_results/` for meaningful Kaggle validations, sweeps, failures, or launches.

## Response Style

- Be explicit about whether you changed source code, notebook config only, or only launched/monitored a run.
- Include Kaggle kernel slug/version/status when known.
- Include exact local report/log paths in `test_results/`.
- Keep recommendations tied to evidence from logs, not guesses.
- If the next step requires exporting source or publishing publicly, ask for explicit approval first.

То есть окружение теперь исправлено: сборка, NCCL, torchrun, 8 GPU стартуют. Падает на depth 7, потому что для ряда logical shards оба A/B буфера фактически заполнены: выбранный буфер почти полный, sibling буфер полностью dirty и `processing_flag=1`. При `GLOBAL_SPILL_CAPACITY=0` это fatal.

Текущий конфиг для A100 слишком тесный по shard capacity / Stream4 drain:

```bash
BEAM_SHARD_CAPACITY_CANDIDATES=1052672
BEAM_STREAM4_BATCH_CANDIDATES=524288
BEAM_STREAM4_TRIGGER_CANDIDATES=1048576
BEAM_SHARD_COUNT=64
```

Для следующей попытки без изменения кода я бы поднял capacity и/или сделал Stream4 раньше:

```bash
BEAM_SHARD_CAPACITY_CANDIDATES=1641472
BEAM_STREAM4_TRIGGER_CANDIDATES=786432
```

`STREAM4_BATCH_CANDIDATES=524288` можно оставить. Это близко к Molab-тюнингу для 260M/64 shards, но на 40GB A100 надо проверить память.

# Work With Kaggle

Use this skill whenever the task involves Kaggle notebooks, kernels, datasets, or GPU validation runs.

## Project Memory First

For project repositories, read local project guidance before changing notebooks or source:

- `AGENTS.md`
- `memory/PROMPTS.md` and `memory/CHANGELOG.md`, especially recent Kaggle entries
- relevant `test_results/kaggle_*` reports for the same failure/config family

This project has many Kaggle-specific decisions preserved in memory. Do not assume a generic Kaggle workflow is correct when project memory says otherwise.

## Safety And Scope

- Do not upload or publish current uncommitted source to a Kaggle dataset unless the user explicitly approves external export.
- Prefer GitHub-backed Kaggle source when the user has selected GitHub as source of truth.
- Do not push a public Kaggle notebook/kernel unless the user explicitly approves publication or public push.
- Do not make C++/CUDA algorithmic changes while diagnosing Kaggle failures unless the user explicitly approves code changes. Config-only notebook changes are acceptable when useful and consistent with the request.
- Do not revert unrelated local changes. Kaggle notebook edits often coexist with dirty source changes.
- For multi-rank validation, do not fake `WORLD_SIZE=2` on one GPU with both ranks on `LOCAL_RANK=0` unless the user explici<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="692" />ed logs. This rule came from project memory and applies to diagnostic/watch tasks.
- Do not stop production/no-timeout runs unless the user explicitly asks or the notebook itself has a configured timeout.
- If a run appears hung because stdout is redirected, check rank log files and whether live-rank streaming is enabled before assuming a stall.
- Preserve logs even when stopping: terminate gracefully when possible, then download output files.

## Failure Diagnosis Checklist

After a Kaggle failure, collect and scan:

- Kaggle worker status and kernel version
- notebook stdout tail
- rank logs under the notebook output directory
- result JSONL/CSV summaries
- GPU budget/preflight output
- explicit Kaggle messages such as disk quota failures

Common patterns in this project:

- `KernelWorkerStatus.ERROR` plus "more disk space than is available" usually means disk quota/static history arena pressure.
- `return_code=-9` can indicate host RAM OOM.
- `code=3002` / `STREAM_FATAL_STREAM3_DOUBLE_BUFFER_OVERFLOW` points to Stream3/Stream4/threshold/capacity flow diagnostics.
- `final selected count does not match score phase counts` points to final selection/histogram/exact-count mismatch.
- `cudaGraphInstantiate: out of memory` may require config-only headroom/shard-capacity changes before deeper code work.
- Silent output after build may simply mean rank stdout is redirected and live rank logging is disabled.

Write a short report under `test_results/` for meaningful Kaggle validations, sweeps, failures, or launches.

## Response Style

- Be explicit about whether you changed source code, notebook config only, or only launched/monitored a run.
- Include Kaggle kernel slug/version/status when known.
- Include exact local report/log paths in `test_results/`.
- Keep recommendations tied to evidence from logs, not guesses.
- If the next step requires exporting source or publishing publicly, ask for explicit approval first.

#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=beam8a100
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks=1
#SBATCH --gres=gpu:8
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=8
#SBATCH --time=12:00:00

set -euo pipefail

JOB_DIR="${SLURM_SUBMIT_DIR:-/mnt/pool/6/vokirova/beam8a100}"
REPO_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/repo"
BUILD_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/build-a100"
CUTLASS_DIR="${CUTLASS_DIR:-/mnt/pool/3/vokirova/cutlass}"
NINJA_VENV_DIR="${NINJA_VENV_DIR:-/mnt/pool/3/vokirova/ninja-venv}"
NCCL_INCLUDE_DIR="${NCCL_INCLUDE_DIR:-${NINJA_VENV_DIR}/lib/python3.13/site-packages/nvidia/nccl/include}"
NCCL_LIBRARY="${NCCL_LIBRARY:-${NINJA_VENV_DIR}/lib/python3.13/site-packages/nvidia/nccl/lib/libnccl.so.2}"
HISTORY_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/history"
LOG_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/logs"
PREDICT_STATS_PATH="${JOB_DIR}/predict_stats_p992_b260m_d12.jsonl"
PUZZLE_ID="${PUZZLE_ID:-992}"
DEPTH_LIMIT="${DEPTH_LIMIT:-12}"
BEAM_WIDTH="${BEAM_WIDTH:-260000000}"
TORCHRUN_NNODES="${TORCHRUN_NNODES:-1}"
TORCHRUN_NPROC_PER_NODE="${TORCHRUN_NPROC_PER_NODE:-8}"
TORCHRUN_NODE_RANK="${TORCHRUN_NODE_RANK:-${SLURM_NODEID:-0}}"
TORCHRUN_RDZV_ENDPOINT="${TORCHRUN_RDZV_ENDPOINT:-127.0.0.1:29500}"
SHARD_COUNT="${SHARD_COUNT:-64}"
STREAM4_BATCH_ALIGNMENT="${STREAM4_BATCH_ALIGNMENT:-1024}"
SHARD_CAPACITY_SCALE_PPM="${SHARD_CAPACITY_SCALE_PPM:-1050000}"
STREAM4_BATCH_CANDIDATES="${STREAM4_BATCH_CANDIDATES:-524288}"
STREAM4_TRIGGER_CANDIDATES="${STREAM4_TRIGGER_CANDIDATES:-524288}"

safe_remove_job_child_dir() {
  local target="$1"
  local label="$2"
  local resolved_job
  local resolved_target

  resolved_job="$(realpath -m "${JOB_DIR}")"
  resolved_target="$(realpath -m "${target}")"
  case "${resolved_target}" in
    "${resolved_job}/build-a100"|"${resolved_job}/history")
      if [ -d "${resolved_target}" ]; then
        echo "cleanup_remove_${label}=${resolved_target}"
        rm -rf --one-file-system "${resolved_target}"
      fi
      ;;
    *)
      echo "cleanup_skip_${label}=unsafe_path:${resolved_target}"
      ;;
  esac

export CUDA_DEVICE_MAX_CONNECTIONS=32

export BEAM_WEIGHT_DIR="${REPO_DIR}/stream1_weights"
export BEAM_DEPTH_LOG_EVERY=1
export BEAM_HISTORY_MODE=static_hybrid
export BEAM_HISTORY_SLOT_COUNT=2
export BEAM_HISTORY_WORKERS=4
export BEAM_HISTORY_RAM_BYTES=$((160 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024))
export BEAM_HISTORY_DISK_BYTES=$((384 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024))
export BEAM_HISTORY_DISK_PATH="${HISTORY_DIR}"
export BEAM_SOLVED_NEIGHBORHOOD_RADIUS=5
export BEAM_SOLVED_NEIGHBORHOOD_MAX_ENTRIES=3000000
export BEAM_STREAM2_SUFFIX_RADIUS=0
export BEAM_STREAM2_SUFFIX_BACKEND=composed_permutations
export BEAM_STREAM2_SUFFIX_MAX_COUNT=1
export BEAM_PREDICT_STATS_VERBOSE=1
export BEAM_PREDICT_STATS_PATH="${PREDICT_STATS_PATH}"

export BEAM_RUNTIME_CONFIG_MODE=manual
export BEAM_B_MICRO=4096
export BEAM_STREAM1_CONCURRENCY=2
export BEAM_STREAM3_RING_SLOTS=4
export BEAM_SHARD_BUFFER_COUNT=2
export BEAM_SHARD_COUNT="${SHARD_COUNT}"
export BEAM_STREAM4_BATCH_CANDIDATES="${STREAM4_BATCH_CANDIDATES}"
export BEAM_STREAM4_TRIGGER_CANDIDATES="${STREAM4_TRIGGER_CANDIDATES}"
export BEAM_SHARD_CAPACITY_CANDIDATES="${SHARD_CAPACITY_CANDIDATES}"
export BEAM_SHARD_CAPACITY_SCALE_PPM="${SHARD_CAPACITY_SCALE_PPM}"
export BEAM_STREAM4_ACTIVE_SORT_SLOTS=4
export BEAM_GLOBAL_SPILL_CAPACITY=0
export BEAM_STREAM5_RECV_CAPACITY_SCALE_PPM=1200000
export BEAM_GPU_HEADROOM_BYTES=$((3 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024))

RUN_LOG="${LOG_DIR}/production_runner_p${PUZZLE_ID}_d${DEPTH_LIMIT}_b${BEAM_WIDTH}_${SLURM_JOB_ID:-manual}.log"
echo "run_log=${RUN_LOG}"

"${NINJA_VENV_DIR}/bin/python" -m torch.distributed.run \
  --nnodes="${TORCHRUN_NNODES}" \
  --nproc-per-node="${TORCHRUN_NPROC_PER_NODE}" \
  --node-rank="${TORCHRUN_NODE_RANK}" \
  --rdzv-backend=c10d \
  --rdzv-endpoint="${TORCHRUN_RDZV_ENDPOINT}" \
  --rdzv-id="beam8a100_${SLURM_JOB_ID:-manual}" \
  --no-python \
  "${BUILD_DIR}/production_runner" "${PUZZLE_ID}" "${DEPTH_LIMIT}" "${BEAM_WIDTH}" 2>&1 | tee "${RUN_LOG}"

echo "finished_at=$(date -Is)"

RuntimeConfigBuild build_manual_runtime_config(
    RuntimeConfig base,
    const Stream1ModelConfig& stream1_model,
    std::uint64_t free_before_bytes,
    std::uint64_t gpu_headroom_bytes,
    std::uint32_t stream4_flow_scale_ppm) {
    RuntimeConfigBuild build;
    build.manual_config = true;
    build.config = base;
    build.gpu_headroom_bytes = gpu_headroom_bytes;
    build.gpu_budget_bytes =
        free_before_bytes > build.gpu_headroom_bytes ? free_before_bytes - build.gpu_headroom_bytes : 0ULL;
    build.stream3_ring_slots = required_env_u32("BEAM_STREAM3_RING_SLOTS");
    build.config.s<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="240" />env_u32("BEAM_RING_COUNT", 1);
    } else {
        set_ring_count_from_logical_shard(build.config);
    }
    if (build.config.stream4_batch_candidates % build.config.stream4_batch_alignment != 0U) {
        throw std::invalid_argument("manual BEAM_STREAM4_BATCH_CANDIDATES must be aligned to BEAM_STREAM4_BATCH_ALIGNMENT");
    }
    if (build.config.stream4_trigger_candidates == 0U) {
        throw std::invalid_argument("manual BEAM_STREAM4_TRIGGER_CANDIDATES must be nonzero");
    }
    if (build.config.shard_capacity_candidates < logical_shard_size_for(build.config)) {
        throw std::invalid_argument("manual BEAM_SHARD_CAPACITY_CANDIDATES must be at least LOGICAL_SHARD_SIZE");
    }
    if (build.config.stream4_batch_candidates > build.config.shard_capacity_candidates) {
        throw std::invalid_argument("manual BEAM_STREAM4_BATCH_CANDIDATES must not exceed BEAM_SHARD_CAPACITY_CANDIDATES");
    }
    if (build.config.stream4_trigger_candidates > build.config.shard_capacity_candidates) {
        throw std::invalid_argument("manual BEAM_STREAM4_TRIGGER_CANDIDATES must not exceed BEAM_SHARD_CAPACITY_CANDIDATES");
    }
    if (build.config.stream3_batch_candidates > build.config.shard_capacity_candidates) {
        throw std::invalid_argument("manual STREAM3_BATCH_CANDIDATES must not exceed BEAM_SHARD_CAPACITY_CANDIDATES");
    }
    if (build.config.shard_buffer_count != 2U) {
        throw std::invalid_argument("manual BEAM_SHARD_BUFFER_COUNT must be 2");
    }
    if (build.config.ring_count == 0U) {
        throw std::invalid_argument("manual RING_COUNT must be nonzero");
    }
    fill_runtime_config_build_estimates(build, stream1_model, stream4_flow_scale_ppm, free_before_bytes);
    return build;
}

#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=beam8a100
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks=1
#SBATCH --gres=gpu:8
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=8
#SBATCH --time=12:00:00

set -euo pipefail

JOB_DIR="${SLURM_SUBMIT_DIR:-/mnt/pool/6/vokirova/beam8a100}"
REPO_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/repo"
BUILD_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/build-a100"
CUTLASS_DIR="${CUTLASS_DIR:-/mnt/pool/3/vokirova/cutlass}"
NINJA_VENV_DIR="${NINJA_VENV_DIR:-/mnt/pool/3/vokirova/ninja-venv}"
NCCL_INCLUDE_DIR="${NCCL_INCLUDE_DIR:-${NINJA_VENV_DIR}/lib/python3.13/site-packages/nvidia/nccl/include}"
NCCL_LIBRARY="${NCCL_LIBRARY:-${NINJA_VENV_DIR}/lib/python3.13/site-packages/nvidia/nccl/lib/libnccl.so.2}"
HISTORY_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/history"
LOG_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/logs"
PREDICT_STATS_PATH="${JOB_DIR}/predict_stats_p992_b260m_d12.jsonl"
PUZZLE_ID="${PUZZLE_ID:-992}"
DEPTH_LIMIT="${DEPTH_LIMIT:-12}"
BEAM_WIDTH="${BEAM_WIDTH:-260000000}"
TORCHRUN_NNODES="${TORCHRUN_NNODES:-1}"
TORCHRUN_NPROC_PER_NODE="${TORCHRUN_NPROC_PER_NODE:-8}"
TORCHRUN_NODE_RANK="${TORCHRUN_NODE_RANK:-${SLURM_NODEID:-0}}"
TORCHRUN_RDZV_ENDPOINT="${TORCHRUN_RDZV_ENDPOINT:-127.0.0.1:29500}"
SHARD_COUNT="${SHARD_COUNT:-64}"
STREAM4_BATCH_ALIGNMENT="${STREAM4_BATCH_ALIGNMENT:-1024}"
SHARD_CAPACITY_SCALE_PPM="${SHARD_CAPACITY_SCALE_PPM:-1050000}"
STREAM4_BATCH_CANDIDATES="${STREAM4_BATCH_CANDIDATES:-524288}"
STREAM4_TRIGGER_CANDIDATES="${STREAM4_TRIGGER_CANDIDATES:-524288}"

safe_remove_job_child_dir() {
  local target="$1"
  local label="$2"
  local resolved_job
  local resolved_target

  resolved_job="$(realpath -m "${JOB_DIR}")"
  resolved_target="$(realpath -m "${target}")"
  case "${resolved_target}" in
    "${resolved_job}/build-a100"|"${resolved_job}/history")
      if [ -d "${resolved_target}" ]; then
        echo "cleanup_remove_${label}=${resolved_target}"
        rm -rf --one-file-system "${resolved_target}"
      fi
      ;;
    *)
      echo "cleanup_skip_${label}=unsafe_path:${resolved_target}"
      ;;
  esac

export CUDA_DEVICE_MAX_CONNECTIONS=32

export BEAM_WEIGHT_DIR="${REPO_DIR}/stream1_weights"
export BEAM_DEPTH_LOG_EVERY=1
export BEAM_HISTORY_MODE=static_hybrid
export BEAM_HISTORY_SLOT_COUNT=2
export BEAM_HISTORY_WORKERS=4
export BEAM_HISTORY_RAM_BYTES=$((160 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024))
export BEAM_HISTORY_DISK_BYTES=$((384 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024))
export BEAM_HISTORY_DISK_PATH="${HISTORY_DIR}"
export BEAM_SOLVED_NEIGHBORHOOD_RADIUS=5
export BEAM_SOLVED_NEIGHBORHOOD_MAX_ENTRIES=3000000
export BEAM_STREAM2_SUFFIX_RADIUS=0
export BEAM_STREAM2_SUFFIX_BACKEND=composed_permutations
export BEAM_STREAM2_SUFFIX_MAX_COUNT=1
export BEAM_PREDICT_STATS_VERBOSE=1
export BEAM_PREDICT_STATS_PATH="${PREDICT_STATS_PATH}"

export BEAM_RUNTIME_CONFIG_MODE=manual
export BEAM_B_MICRO=4096
export BEAM_STREAM1_CONCURRENCY=2
export BEAM_STREAM3_RING_SLOTS=4
export BEAM_SHARD_BUFFER_COUNT=2
export BEAM_SHARD_COUNT="${SHARD_COUNT}"
export BEAM_STREAM4_BATCH_CANDIDATES="${STREAM4_BATCH_CANDIDATES}"
export BEAM_STREAM4_TRIGGER_CANDIDATES="${STREAM4_TRIGGER_CANDIDATES}"
export BEAM_SHARD_CAPACITY_CANDIDATES="${SHARD_CAPACITY_CANDIDATES}"
export BEAM_SHARD_CAPACITY_SCALE_PPM="${SHARD_CAPACITY_SCALE_PPM}"
export BEAM_STREAM4_ACTIVE_SORT_SLOTS=4
export BEAM_GLOBAL_SPILL_CAPACITY=0
export BEAM_STREAM5_RECV_CAPACITY_SCALE_PPM=1200000
export BEAM_GPU_HEADROOM_BYTES=$((3 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024))

RUN_LOG="${LOG_DIR}/production_runner_p${PUZZLE_ID}_d${DEPTH_LIMIT}_b${BEAM_WIDTH}_${SLURM_JOB_ID:-manual}.log"
echo "run_log=${RUN_LOG}"

"${NINJA_VENV_DIR}/bin/python" -m torch.distributed.run \
  --nnodes="${TORCHRUN_NNODES}" \
  --nproc-per-node="${TORCHRUN_NPROC_PER_NODE}" \
  --node-rank="${TORCHRUN_NODE_RANK}" \
  --rdzv-backend=c10d \
  --rdzv-endpoint="${TORCHRUN_RDZV_ENDPOINT}" \
  --rdzv-id="beam8a100_${SLURM_JOB_ID:-manual}" \
  --no-python \
  "${BUILD_DIR}/production_runner" "${PUZZLE_ID}" "${DEPTH_LIMIT}" "${BEAM_WIDTH}" 2>&1 | tee "${RUN_LOG}"

echo "finished_at=$(date -Is)"

WORLD_SIZE_EFFECTIVE=$((TORCHRUN_NNODES * TORCHRUN_NPROC_PER_NODE))

[267] assistant: `31077` уже новый скрипт: сборка прошла, run log новый:

```text
production_runner_p992_d12_b260000000_31077.log
```

Падает теперь не из-за capacity, а на NCCL init:

```text
ncclCommInitRank: unhandled system error
```

Нашел причину в коде: `production_runner` сам делает `ncclGetUniqueId / ncclCommInitRank` через файл:

```cpp
BEAM_NCCL_ID_FILE
default: /tmp/beam_solver_nccl_id.bin
```

В Kaggle notebook это было явно:

```python
rank_env['BEAM_NCCL_ID_FILE'] = str(nccl_id_file)
```

А в torchrun-скрипте мы это не добавили. Все 8 процессов сейчас, скорее всего, дерутся за дефолтный `/tmp/beam_solver_nccl_id.bin` или читают stale id.

Нужно добавить перед torchrun:

```bash
NCCL_ID_FILE="${JOB_DIR}/beam_solver_nccl_${SLURM_JOB_ID:-manual}.bin"
rm -f "${NCCL_ID_FILE}"
export BEAM_NCCL_ID_FILE="${NCCL_ID_FILE}"
echo "beam_nccl_id_file=${BEAM_NCCL_ID_FILE}"
```

Это ровно недостающая часть Kaggle runner при переходе на torchrun.

Падает теперь не из-за capacity, а на NCCL init:

```text
ncclCommInitRank: unhandled system error
```

Нашел причину в коде: `production_runner` сам делает `ncclGetUniqueId / ncclCommInitRank` через файл:

```cpp
BEAM_NCCL_ID_FILE
default: /tmp/beam_solver_nccl_id.bin
```

В Kaggle notebook это было явно:

```python
rank_env['BEAM_NCCL_ID_FILE'] = str(nccl_id_file)
```

А в torchrun-скрипте мы это не добавили. Все 8 процессов сейчас, скорее всего, дерутся за дефолтный `/tmp/beam_solver_nccl_id.bin` или читают stale id.

Нужно добавить перед torchrun:

```bash
NCCL_ID_FILE="${JOB_DIR}/beam_solver_nccl_${SLURM_JOB_ID:-manual}.bin"
rm -f "${NCCL_ID_FILE}"
export BEAM_NCCL_ID_FILE="${NCCL_ID_FILE}"
echo "beam_nccl_id_file=${BEAM_NCCL_ID_FILE}"
```

Это ровно недостающая часть Kaggle runner при переходе на torchrun.

[291] assistant: Внутри выделенной job проще всего так.

GPU загрузка:

```bash
srun --jobid=<JOB_ID> nvidia-smi
```

или живой монитор:

```bash
srun --jobid=<JOB_ID> watch -n 2 nvidia-smi
```

Если `srun --jobid` не разрешен, смотри через `slurm`-лог, либо зайди на compute-node только для мониторинга:

```bash
ssh t2n1
watch -n 2 nvidia-smi
```

RAM/CPU по SLURM:

```bash
sstat -j <JOB_ID>.batch --format=JobID,MaxRSS,AveRSS,MaxVMSize,AveCPU,NTasks
```

Подробно по job:

```bash
scontrol show job <JOB_ID>
```

На самом узле общая RAM:

```bash
ssh t2n1
free -h
watch -n 2 free -h
```

Для текущего последнего job просто подставь номер, например:

```bash
sstat -j 31077.batch --format=JobID,MaxRSS,AveRSS,MaxVMSize,AveCPU,NTasks
srun --jobid=31077 nvidia-smi
```

[291] assistant: Внутри выделенной job проще всего так.

GPU загрузка:

```bash
srun --jobid=<JOB_ID> nvidia-smi
```

или живой монитор:

```bash
srun --jobid=<JOB_ID> watch -n 2 nvidia-smi
```

Если `srun --jobid` не разрешен, смотри через `slurm`-лог, либо зайди на compute-node только для мониторинга:

```bash
ssh t2n1
watch -n 2 nvidia-smi
```

RAM/CPU по SLURM:

```bash
sstat -j <JOB_ID>.batch --format=JobID,MaxRSS,AveRSS,MaxVMSize,AveCPU,NTasks
```

Подробно по job:

```bash
scontrol show job <JOB_ID>
```

На самом узле общая RAM:

```bash
ssh t2n1
free -h
watch -n 2 free -h
```

Для текущего последнего job просто подставь номер, например:

```bash
sstat -j 31077.batch --format=JobID,MaxRSS,AveRSS,MaxVMSize,AveCPU,NTasks
srun --jobid=31077 nvidia-smi
```

+# MEPhI 8xA100 tuning scripts
+
+Date: 2026-06-04
+
+Prepared a three-step SLURM tuning workflow for `basis/kaf12`:
+
+1. `hpc/tune_8xa100_stream1.sh`
+   - builds `stream_benchmark`;
+   - tests the compiled Stream1 sweep for `B_MICRO` and inference concurrency;
+   - writes `logs/best_stream1.env`.
+
+2. `hpc/tune_8xa100_pipeline.sh`
+   - builds `production_runner`;
+   - sources `logs/best_stream1.env` when present;
+   - sweeps shard count, Stream3 ring slots, Stream4 batch, and Stream4 trigger;
+   - runs every valid config through torchrun on 8 ranks to `DEPTH_LIMIT=12`;
+   - writes `logs/tuning_<job_id>/pipeline_sweep_<job_id>.tsv`;
+   - writes the fastest passing config to `logs/best_pipeline.env`.
+
+3. `hpc/start_8xa100_best.sh`
+   - sources `logs/best_pipeline.env` when present;
+   - derives per-rank shard capacity from local beam and shard count;
+   - launches the selected production config through torchrun.
+
+Shared logic:
+
+- `hpc/mephi_8xa100_common.sh` owns MEPhI paths, venv/NCCL/CUTLASS preflight,
+  CMake/Ninja build flags, Kaggle-style local-beam shard-capacity derivation,
+  manual config guards, NCCL id-file setup, and rank-separated torchrun logging.
+
+Safety notes:
+
+- No compute payload runs outside SLURM.
+- The scripts do not clone/fetch/reset inside compute jobs.
+- Rank 0 writes the main log; other ranks write under `logs/ranks_<job>_<tag>/`.
+- Configs are rejected before launch if Stream4 batch/trigger or Stream3 batch
+  cannot fit in a physical shard buffer, or if Stream1 concurrency exceeds
+  Stream3 ring slots.
+
+Local verification:
+
+- Windows WSL `bash -n` was unavailable in this Codex environment due
+  `Bash/Service/CreateInstance/E_ACCESSDENIED`.
+- Static inspection was performed locally; final `bash -n` should be run on
+  `basis` after copying scripts and stripping CRLF.

#!/bin/bash

beam_setup_paths() {
  JOB_DIR="${SLURM_SUBMIT_DIR:-/mnt/pool/6/vokirova/beam8a100}"
  REPO_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/repo"
  BUILD_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/build-a100"
  CUTLASS_DIR="${CUTLASS_DIR:-/mnt/pool/3/vokirova/cutlass}"
  NINJA_VENV_DIR="${NINJA_VENV_DIR:-/mnt/pool/3/vokirova/ninja-venv}"
  NCCL_INCLUDE_DIR="${NCCL_INCLUDE_DIR:-${NINJA_VENV_DIR}/lib/python3.13/site-packages/nvidia/nccl/include}"
  NCCL_LIBRARY="${NCCL_LIBRARY:-${NINJA_VENV_DIR}/lib/python3.13/site-packages/nvidia/nccl/lib/libnccl.so.2}"
  HISTORY_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/history"
  LOG_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/logs"
  TUNING_DIR="${LOG_DIR}/tuning_${SLURM_JOB_ID:-manual}"
  TORCHRUN_NNODES="${TORCHRUN_NNODES:-1}"
  TORCHRUN_NPROC_PER_NODE="${TORCHRUN_NPROC_PER_NODE:-8}"
  TORCHRUN_NODE_RANK="${TORCHRUN_NODE_RANK:-${SLURM_NODEID:-0}}"
  TORCHRUN_RDZV_ENDPOINT="${TORCHRUN_RDZV_ENDPOINT:-127.0.0.1:29500}"
  WORLD_SIZE_EFFECTIVE=$((TORCHRUN_NNODES * TORCHRUN_NPROC_PER_NODE))
}

beam_preflight() {
  mkdir -p "${JOB_DIR}" "${BUILD_DIR}" "${HISTORY_DIR}" "${LOG_DIR}" "${TUNING_DIR}"
  if [ -x "${NINJA_VENV_DIR}/bin/ninja" ]; then
    export PATH="${NINJA_VENV_DIR}/bin:${PATH}"
  else
    echo "missing_ninja=${NINJA_VENV_DIR}/bin/ninja"
    exit 2
  fi
  if [ ! -x "${NINJA_VENV_DIR}/bin/python" ]; then
    echo "missing_python=${NINJA_VENV_DIR}/bin/python"
    exit 2
  fi
  if [ ! -f "${NCCL_INCLUDE_DIR}/nccl.h" ]; then
    echo "missing_nccl_header=${NCCL_INCLUDE_DIR}/nccl.h"
    exit 2
  fi
  if [ ! -f "${NCCL_LIBRARY}" ]; then
    echo "missing_nccl_library=${NCCL_LIBRARY}"
    exit 2
  fi
  if [ ! -d "${REPO_DIR}/.git" ]; then
    echo "missing_repo=${REPO_DIR}"
    exit 2
  fi
  if [ ! -d "${CUTLASS_DIR}/include" ]; then
    echo "missing_cutlass=${CUTLASS_DIR}"
    exit 2
  fi
  cd "${REPO_DIR}"
  echo "job_dir=${JOB_DIR}"
  echo "repo_dir=${REPO_DIR}"
  echo "git_head=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
  echo "started_at=$(date -Is)"
  echo "world_size_effective<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="1122" />SORT_SLOTS}"
  export BEAM_GLOBAL_SPILL_CAPACITY="${BEAM_GLOBAL_SPILL_CAPACITY:-0}"
  export BEAM_STREAM5_RECV_CAPACITY_SCALE_PPM="${BEAM_STREAM5_RECV_CAPACITY_SCALE_PPM:-1200000}"
  export BEAM_GPU_HEADROOM_BYTES="${BEAM_GPU_HEADROOM_BYTES:-$((3 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024))}"
}

beam_prepare_nccl_file() {
  NCCL_ID_FILE="${JOB_DIR}/beam_solver_nccl_${SLURM_JOB_ID:-manual}_${1:-run}.bin"
  rm -f "${NCCL_ID_FILE}"
  export BEAM_NCCL_ID_FILE="${NCCL_ID_FILE}"
}

beam_torchrun_production() {
  local run_tag="$1"
  local run_log="$2"
  local rank_log_dir="${LOG_DIR}/ranks_${SLURM_JOB_ID:-manual}_${run_tag}"
  mkdir -p "${rank_log_dir}"
  export BEAM_RANK_LOG_DIR="${rank_log_dir}"
  echo "run_tag=${run_tag}"
  echo "run_log=${run_log}"
  echo "rank_log_dir=${BEAM_RANK_LOG_DIR}"
  echo "beam_nccl_id_file=${BEAM_NCCL_ID_FILE}"
  "${NINJA_VENV_DIR}/bin/python" -m torch.distributed.run \
    --nnodes="${TORCHRUN_NNODES}" \
    --nproc-per-node="${TORCHRUN_NPROC_PER_NODE}" \
    --node-rank="${TORCHRUN_NODE_RANK}" \
    --rdzv-backend=c10d \
    --rdzv-endpoint="${TORCHRUN_RDZV_ENDPOINT}" \
    --rdzv-id="beam8a100_${SLURM_JOB_ID:-manual}_${run_tag}" \
    --no-python \
    /bin/bash -lc 'if [ "${RANK:-0}" = "0" ]; then exec "$@"; else exec "$@" > "${BEAM_RANK_LOG_DIR}/rank${RANK}.log" 2>&1; fi' \
    bash "${BUILD_DIR}/production_runner" "${PUZZLE_ID}" "${DEPTH_LIMIT}" "${BEAM_WIDTH}" 2>&1 | tee "${run_log}"
}

beam_safe_clean_child() {
  local target="$1"
  local label="$2"
  local resolved_job
  local resolved_target
  resolved_job="$(realpath -m "${JOB_DIR}")"
  resolved_target="$(realpath -m "${target}")"
  case "${resolved_target}" in
    "${resolved_job}/build-a100"|"${resolved_job}/history")
      if [ -d "${resolved_target}" ]; then
        echo "cleanup_remove_${label}=${resolved_target}"
        rm -rf --one-file-system "${resolved_target}"
      fi
      ;;
    *)
      echo "cleanup_skip_${label}=unsafe_path:${resolved_target}"
      ;;
  esac
}

  cat "${LOG_DIR}/best_stream1.env"
fi

echo "stream1_report=${BEAM_BENCHMARK_REPORT}"
echo "finished_at=$(date -Is)"

+# MEPhI 8xA100 tuning scripts
+
+Date: 2026-06-04
+
+Prepared a three-step SLURM tuning workflow for `basis/kaf12`:
+
+1. `hpc/tune_8xa100_stream1.sh`
+   - builds `stream_benchmark`;
+   - tests the compiled Stream1 sweep for `B_MICRO` and inference concurrency;
+   - writes `logs/best_stream1.env`.
+
+2. `hpc/tune_8xa100_pipeline.sh`
+   - builds `production_runner`;
+   - sources `logs/best_stream1.env` when present;
+   - sweeps shard count, Stream3 ring slots, Stream4 batch, and Stream4 trigger;
+   - runs every valid config through torchrun on 8 ranks to `DEPTH_LIMIT=12`;
+   - writes `logs/tuning_<job_id>/pipeline_sweep_<job_id>.tsv`;
+   - writes the fastest passing config to `logs/best_pipeline.env`.
+
+3. `hpc/start_8xa100_best.sh`
+   - sources `logs/best_pipeline.env` when present;
+   - derives per-rank shard capacity from local beam and shard count;
+   - launches the selected production config through torchrun.
+
+Shared logic:
+
+- `hpc/mephi_8xa100_common.sh` owns MEPhI paths, venv/NCCL/CUTLASS preflight,
+  CMake/Ninja build flags, Kaggle-style local-beam shard-capacity derivation,
+  manual config guards, NCCL id-file setup, and rank-separated torchrun logging.
+
+Safety notes:
+
+- No compute payload runs outside SLURM.
+- The scripts do not clone/fetch/reset inside compute jobs.
+- Rank 0 writes the main log; other ranks write under `logs/ranks_<job>_<tag>/`.
+- Configs are rejected before launch if Stream4 batch/trigger or Stream3 batch
+  cannot fit in a physical shard buffer, or if Stream1 concurrency exceeds
+  Stream3 ring slots.
+
+Local verification:
+
+- Windows WSL `bash -n` was unavailable in this Codex environment due
+  `Bash/Service/CreateInstance/E_ACCESSDENIED`.
+- Static inspection was performed locally; final `bash -n` should be run on
+  `basis` after copying scripts and stripping CRLF.

#!/bin/bash

beam_setup_paths() {
  JOB_DIR="${SLURM_SUBMIT_DIR:-/mnt/pool/6/vokirova/beam8a100}"
  REPO_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/repo"
  BUILD_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/build-a100"
  CUTLASS_DIR="${CUTLASS_DIR:-/mnt/pool/3/vokirova/cutlass}"
  NINJA_VENV_DIR="${NINJA_VENV_DIR:-/mnt/pool/3/vokirova/ninja-venv}"
  NCCL_INCLUDE_DIR="${NCCL_INCLUDE_DIR:-${NINJA_VENV_DIR}/lib/python3.13/site-packages/nvidia/nccl/include}"
  NCCL_LIBRARY="${NCCL_LIBRARY:-${NINJA_VENV_DIR}/lib/python3.13/site-packages/nvidia/nccl/lib/libnccl.so.2}"
  HISTORY_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/history"
  LOG_DIR="${JOB_DIR}/logs"
  TUNING_DIR="${LOG_DIR}/tuning_${SLURM_JOB_ID:-manual}"
  TORCHRUN_NNODES="${TORCHRUN_NNODES:-1}"
  TORCHRUN_NPROC_PER_NODE="${TORCHRUN_NPROC_PER_NODE:-8}"
  TORCHRUN_NODE_RANK="${TORCHRUN_NODE_RANK:-${SLURM_NODEID:-0}}"
  TORCHRUN_RDZV_ENDPOINT="${TORCHRUN_RDZV_ENDPOINT:-127.0.0.1:29500}"
  WORLD_SIZE_EFFECTIVE=$((TORCHRUN_NNODES * TORCHRUN_NPROC_PER_NODE))
}

beam_preflight() {
  mkdir -p "${JOB_DIR}" "${BUILD_DIR}" "${HISTORY_DIR}" "${LOG_DIR}" "${TUNING_DIR}"
  if [ -x "${NINJA_VENV_DIR}/bin/ninja" ]; then
    export PATH="${NINJA_VENV_DIR}/bin:${PATH}"
  else
    echo "missing_ninja=${NINJA_VENV_DIR}/bin/ninja"
    exit 2
  fi
  if [ ! -x "${NINJA_VENV_DIR}/bin/python" ]; then
    echo "missing_python=${NINJA_VENV_DIR}/bin/python"
    exit 2
  fi
  if [ ! -f "${NCCL_INCLUDE_DIR}/nccl.h" ]; then
    echo "missing_nccl_header=${NCCL_INCLUDE_DIR}/nccl.h"
    exit 2
  fi
  if [ ! -f "${NCCL_LIBRARY}" ]; then
    echo "missing_nccl_library=${NCCL_LIBRARY}"
    exit 2
  fi
  if [ ! -d "${REPO_DIR}/.git" ]; then
    echo "missing_repo=${REPO_DIR}"
    exit 2
  fi
  if [ ! -d "${CUTLASS_DIR}/include" ]; then
    echo "missing_cutlass=${CUTLASS_DIR}"
    exit 2
  fi
  cd "${REPO_DIR}"
  echo "job_dir=${JOB_DIR}"
  echo "repo_dir=${REPO_DIR}"
  echo "git_head=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
  echo "started_at=$(date -Is)"
  echo "world_size_effective<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="1122" />SORT_SLOTS}"
  export BEAM_GLOBAL_SPILL_CAPACITY="${BEAM_GLOBAL_SPILL_CAPACITY:-0}"
  export BEAM_STREAM5_RECV_CAPACITY_SCALE_PPM="${BEAM_STREAM5_RECV_CAPACITY_SCALE_PPM:-1200000}"
  export BEAM_GPU_HEADROOM_BYTES="${BEAM_GPU_HEADROOM_BYTES:-$((3 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024))}"
}

beam_prepare_nccl_file() {
  NCCL_ID_FILE="${JOB_DIR}/beam_solver_nccl_${SLURM_JOB_ID:-manual}_${1:-run}.bin"
  rm -f "${NCCL_ID_FILE}"
  export BEAM_NCCL_ID_FILE="${NCCL_ID_FILE}"
}

beam_torchrun_production() {
  local run_tag="$1"
  local run_log="$2"
  local rank_log_dir="${LOG_DIR}/ranks_${SLURM_JOB_ID:-manual}_${run_tag}"
  mkdir -p "${rank_log_dir}"
  export BEAM_RANK_LOG_DIR="${rank_log_dir}"
  echo "run_tag=${run_tag}"
  echo "run_log=${run_log}"
  echo "rank_log_dir=${BEAM_RANK_LOG_DIR}"
  echo "beam_nccl_id_file=${BEAM_NCCL_ID_FILE}"
  "${NINJA_VENV_DIR}/bin/python" -m torch.distributed.run \
    --nnodes="${TORCHRUN_NNODES}" \
    --nproc-per-node="${TORCHRUN_NPROC_PER_NODE}" \
    --node-rank="${TORCHRUN_NODE_RANK}" \
    --rdzv-backend=c10d \
    --rdzv-endpoint="${TORCHRUN_RDZV_ENDPOINT}" \
    --rdzv-id="beam8a100_${SLURM_JOB_ID:-manual}_${run_tag}" \
    --no-python \
    /bin/bash -lc 'if [ "${RANK:-0}" = "0" ]; then exec "$@"; else exec "$@" > "${BEAM_RANK_LOG_DIR}/rank${RANK}.log" 2>&1; fi' \
    bash "${BUILD_DIR}/production_runner" "${PUZZLE_ID}" "${DEPTH_LIMIT}" "${BEAM_WIDTH}" 2>&1 | tee "${run_log}"
}

beam_safe_clean_child() {
  local target="$1"
  local label="$2"
  local resolved_job
  local resolved_target
  resolved_job="$(realpath -m "${JOB_DIR}")"
  resolved_target="$(realpath -m "${target}")"
  case "${resolved_target}" in
    "${resolved_job}/build-a100"|"${resolved_job}/history")
      if [ -d "${resolved_target}" ]; then
        echo "cleanup_remove_${label}=${resolved_target}"
        rm -rf --one-file-system "${resolved_target}"
      fi
      ;;
    *)
      echo "cleanup_skip_${label}=unsafe_path:${resolved_target}"
      ;;
  esac
}

#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --job-name=beam8a100-s1
#SBATCH --nodes=1
#SBATCH --ntasks=1
#SBATCH --gres=gpu:8
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=8
#SBATCH --time=01:00:00

set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
source "${SCRIPT_DIR}/mephi_8xa100_common.sh"

beam_setup_paths
beam_preflight
beam_configure_build stream_benchmark

export BEAM_WEIGHT_DIR="${REPO_DIR}/stream1_weights"
export BEAM_BENCHMARK_REPORT="${TUNING_DIR}/stream1_benchmark_${SLURM_JOB_ID:-manual}.md"
LOG="${TUNING_DIR}/stream1_benchmark_${SLURM_JOB_ID:-manual}.log"

"${BUILD_DIR}/stream_benchmark" "${PUZZLE_ID:-992}" 2>&1 | tee "${LOG}"

BEST_LINE="$(awk '
  /^stream1_micro / {
    cps = "";
    for (i = 1; i <= NF; ++i) {
      if ($i ~ /^candidates_per_sec=/) {
        split($i, a, "=");
        cps = a[2];
      }
    }
    if (cps != "") {
      printf "%020.6f\t%s\n", cps, $0;
    }
  }
' "${LOG}" | sort -nr | head -n 1 | cut -f2- || true)"
if [ -n "${BEST_LINE}" ]; then
  BEST_B_MICRO="$(echo "${BEST_LINE}" | sed -n 's/.*B_MICRO=\([0-9]*\).*/\1/p')"
  BEST_CONCURRENCY="$(echo "${BEST_LINE}" | sed -n 's/.*concurrent=\([0-9]*\).*/\1/p')"
  BEST_CAND_PER_SEC="$(echo "${BEST_LINE}" | sed -n 's/.*candidates_per_sec=\([0-9.]*\).*/\1/p')"
  {
    echo "export BEAM_B_MICRO=${BEST_B_MICRO}"
    echo "export BEAM_STREAM1_CONCURRENCY=${BEST_CONCURRENCY}"
    echo "export STREAM1_CANDIDATES_PER_SEC=${BEST_CAND_PER_SEC}"
  } > "${TUNING_DIR}/best_stream1.env"
  cp "${TUNING_DIR}/best_stream1.env" "${LOG_DIR}/best_stream1.env"
  echo "best_stream1_env=${LOG_DIR}/best_stream1.env"
  cat "${LOG_DIR}/best_stream1.env"
fi

echo "stream1_report=${BEAM_BENCHMARK_REPORT}"
echo "finished_at=$(date -Is)"

        echo -e "${tag}\t${status}\t${avg}\t${SHARD_COUNT}\t${BEAM_B_MICRO}\t${BEAM_STREAM1_CONCURRENCY}\t${BEAM_STREAM3_RING_SLOTS}\t${STREAM3_BATCH_CANDIDATES}\t${STREAM4_BATCH_CANDIDATES}\t${STREAM4_TRIGGER_CANDIDATES}\t${SHARD_CAPACITY_CANDIDATES}\t${LOGICAL_SHARD_SIZE}\t${log}" >> "${SUMMARY}"

        if [ "${status}" = "OK" ] && [ "${avg}" != "NA" ]; then
          if [ -z "${best_avg}" ] || awk "BEGIN { exit !(${avg} < ${best_avg}) }"; then
            best_avg="${avg}"
            best_status="${status}"
            {
              echo "export SHARD_COUNT=${SHARD_COUNT}"
              echo "export SHARD_CAPACITY_SCALE_PPM=${SHARD_CAPACITY_SCALE_PPM}"
              echo "export STREAM4_BATCH_ALIGNMENT=${STREAM4_BATCH_ALIGNMENT}"
              echo "export STREAM4_BATCH_CANDIDATES=${STREAM4_BATCH_CANDIDATES}"
              echo "export STREAM4_TRIGGER_CANDIDATES=${STREAM4_TRIGGER_CANDIDATES}"
              echo "export BEAM_B_MICRO=${BEAM_B_MICRO}"
              echo "export BEAM_STREAM1_CONCURRENCY=${BEAM_STREAM1_CONCURRENCY}"
              echo "export BEAM_STREAM3_RING_SLOTS=${BEAM_STREAM3_RING_SLOTS}"
              echo "export BEAM_STREAM4_ACTIVE_SORT_SLOTS=${BEAM_STREAM4_ACTIVE_SORT_SLOTS}"
              echo "export BEAM_SHARD_BUFFER_COUNT=${BEAM_SHARD_BUFFER_COUNT}"
              echo "export BEST_PIPELINE_AVG_FULL_DEPTH_SEC=${best_avg}"
            } > "${BEST_ENV}"
            cp "${BEST_ENV}" "${LOG_DIR}/best_pipeline.env"
          fi
        fi
      done
    done
  done
done

echo "pipeline_summary=${SUMMARY}"
if [ -n "${best_status}" ]; then
  echo "best_pipeline_env=${LOG_DIR}/best_pipeline.env"
  cat "${LOG_DIR}/best_pipeline.env"
else
  echo "best_pipeline_env=none"
fi
echo "finished_at=$(date -Is)"

# MEPhI 8xA100 Beam Search Launch

Use this only from the visible MEPhI terminal gateway:

```bash
ssh mephi
ssh basis
```

Then prepare and submit:

```bash
JOB=/mnt/pool/6/vokirova/beam8a100
mkdir -p "$JOB"
cd "$JOB"

git clone --branch main --depth 1 https://github.com/TryDotAtwo/MultiGPUBeamSearch.git repo

if [ ! -d /mnt/pool/3/vokirova/cutlass/include ]; then
  mkdir -p /mnt/pool/3/vokirova
  git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/NVIDIA/cutlass.git /mnt/pool/3/vokirova/cutlass
fi

cp repo/hpc/start_8xa100_beamsearch.sh start.sh
cp repo/hpc/mephi_8xa100_common.sh .
sed -i 's/\r$//' start.sh mephi_8xa100_common.sh
bash -n start.sh mephi_8xa100_common.sh
chmod +x start.sh mephi_8xa100_common.sh
sbatch -p kaf12 start.sh
```

To update an existing checkout before resubmitting:

```bash
cd /mnt/pool/6/vokirova/beam8a100/repo
git fetch origin main --depth 1
git reset --hard origin/main

cd /mnt/pool/6/vokirova/beam8a100
cp repo/hpc/start_8xa100_beamsearch.sh start.sh
cp repo/hpc/mephi_8xa100_common.sh .
sed -i 's/\r$//' start.sh mephi_8xa100_common.sh
bash -n start.sh mephi_8xa100_common.sh
chmod +x start.sh mephi_8xa100_common.sh
sbatch -p kaf12 start.sh
```

For the 8xA100 tuning workflow, use the three dedicated launchers instead:

```bash
cd /mnt/pool/6/vokirova/beam8a100
cp repo/hpc/mephi_8xa100_common.sh .
cp repo/hpc/tune_8xa100_stream1.sh .

bash -n tune_8xa100_stream1.sh tune_8xa100_pipeline.sh start_8xa100_best.sh

```

[217] assistant: `31080` завершился успешно, но в нашем parser баг:

```bash
export BEAM_B_MICRO=
export BEAM_STREAM1_CONCURRENCY=8
export STREAM1_CANDIDATES_PER_SEC=87111861.4
```

Лучший Stream1 по логу:

```text
B_MICRO=8192
concurrent=8
candidates_per_sec=87111861.4
```

То есть `BEAM_B_MICRO` должен быть `8192`, а не пустой. Причина: парсер ищет `B_MICRO=...`, а лог пишет `b_micro=...` в нижнем регистре.

Пока вручную исправь env на кластере:

```bash
cd /mnt/pool/6/vokirova/beam8a100

cat > logs/best_stream1.env <<'EOF'
export BEAM_B_MICRO=8192
export BEAM_STREAM1_CONCURRENCY=8
export STREAM1_CANDIDATES_PER_SEC=87111861.4
EOF

cat logs/best_stream1.env
```

Но важное: `BEAM_STREAM1_CONCURRENCY=8` требует `BEAM_STREAM3_RING_SLOTS >= 8`. Наш pipeline sweep сейчас тестирует `2 4`, значит все варианты с этим Stream1 будут invalid. Для следующего запуска нужно либо:

```bash
STREAM3_RING_SLOTS_SWEEP="8" sbatch -p kaf12 tune_8xa100_pipeline.sh
```

либо расширить:

```bash
STREAM3_RING_SLOTS_SWEEP="4 8" sbatch -p kaf12 tune_8xa100_pipeline.sh
```

Я параллельно должен закрепить в GitHub две правки: `SLURM_SUBMIT_DIR` для helper и parser `b_micro`.

[223] user: Так, а 12 зачем?



[224] assistant: `12` не обязателен. Это просто запасной вариант: если `concurrency=8`, то `ring_slots=8` минимально валиден, а `12` даёт больше Stream3 batch:

```text
stream3_batch = ring_slots * B_MICRO * 24
```

При `B_MICRO=8192`:

```text
ring_slots=8  -> stream3_batch=1,572,864
ring_slots=12 -> stream3_batch=2,359,296
```

Но `12` может сильнее давить VRAM и увеличивать latency. Для первого pipeline sweep лучше не надо:

```bash
STREAM3_RING_SLOTS_SWEEP="8" sbatch -p kaf12 tune_8xa100_pipeline.sh
```

Это ровно под найденный `STREAM1_CONCURRENCY=8` без лишнего раздувания.

[202] assistant: Ошибка понятная:

```text
/var/lib/slurm/slurmd/job31079/slurm_script: line 12:
/var/lib/slurm/slurmd/job31079/mephi_8xa100_common.sh: No such file or directory
```

Причина: внутри SLURM `tune_8xa100_stream1.sh` копируется в spool `/var/lib/slurm/...`, и `BASH_SOURCE[0]` указывает туда, а не в `/mnt/pool/6/vokirova/beam8a100`. Поэтому он ищет helper рядом со spool-скриптом.

Нужно исправить `source` на путь через `SLURM_SUBMIT_DIR`. Быстрый hotfix прямо на кластере:

```bash
cd /mnt/pool/6/vokirova/beam8a100

sed -i 's|SCRIPT_DIR=.*|SCRIPT_DIR="${SLURM_SUBMIT_DIR:-$(pwd)}"|' tune_8xa100_stream1.sh tune_8xa100_pipeline.sh start_8xa100_best.sh

bash -n tune_8xa100_stream1.sh tune_8xa100_pipeline.sh start_8xa100_best.sh

sbatch -p kaf12 tune_8xa100_stream1.sh
```

Я у себя тоже должен поправить это в GitHub, потому что это реальный баг в launcher-скриптах.

[217] assistant: `31080` завершился успешно, но в нашем parser баг:

```bash
export BEAM_B_MICRO=
export BEAM_STREAM1_CONCURRENCY=8
export STREAM1_CANDIDATES_PER_SEC=87111861.4
```

Лучший Stream1 по логу:

```text
B_MICRO=8192
concurrent=8
candidates_per_sec=87111861.4
```

То есть `BEAM_B_MICRO` должен быть `8192`, а не пустой. Причина: парсер ищет `B_MICRO=...`, а лог пишет `b_micro=...` в нижнем регистре.

Пока вручную исправь env на кластере:

```bash
cd /mnt/pool/6/vokirova/beam8a100

cat > logs/best_stream1.env <<'EOF'
export BEAM_B_MICRO=8192
export BEAM_STREAM1_CONCURRENCY=8
export STREAM1_CANDIDATES_PER_SEC=87111861.4
EOF

cat logs/best_stream1.env
```

Но важное: `BEAM_STREAM1_CONCURRENCY=8` требует `BEAM_STREAM3_RING_SLOTS >= 8`. Наш pipeline sweep сейчас тестирует `2 4`, значит все варианты с этим Stream1 будут invalid. Для следующего запуска нужно либо:

```bash
STREAM3_RING_SLOTS_SWEEP="8" sbatch -p kaf12 tune_8xa100_pipeline.sh
```

либо расширить:

```bash
STREAM3_RING_SLOTS_SWEEP="4 8" sbatch -p kaf12 tune_8xa100_pipeline.sh
```

Я параллельно должен закрепить в GitHub две правки: `SLURM_SUBMIT_DIR` для helper и parser `b_micro`.

[223] user: Так, а 12 зачем?


[224] assistant: `12` не обязателен. Это просто запасной вариант: если `concurrency=8`, то `ring_slots=8` минимально валиден, а `12` даёт больше Stream3 batch:

```text
stream3_batch = ring_slots * B_MICRO * 24
```

При `B_MICRO=8192`:

```text
ring_slots=8  -> stream3_batch=1,572,864
ring_slots=12 -> stream3_batch=2,359,296
```

Но `12` может сильнее давить VRAM и увеличивать latency. Для первого pipeline sweep лучше не надо:

```bash
STREAM3_RING_SLOTS_SWEEP="8" sbatch -p kaf12 tune_8xa100_pipeline.sh
```

Это ровно под найденный `STREAM1_CONCURRENCY=8` без лишнего раздувания.
